data.title: Sailing from Berkeley to Hawaii in a 19ft Sailboat
data.author: protonbob
data.article_summary: 《Chubby Commutes to Hawaii: 技术讨论》由Bill Teplow撰写，文章讲述了作者作为地质顾问，利用休假时间准备了一次从加州伯克利到夏威夷的航行。他的船是West Wight Potter 19 "Chubby"。在出发前，他进行了大量准备工作，包括增加两个额外的排水口以防浪淹，并在舱口安装防水门以提高安全性。作者还安装了jack lines以便在甲板工作时保持安全。航行距离为2142海里，历时24天，整个过程顺利无重大事故。作者强调，尽管Chubby顺利完成了跨洋航行，但它设计上是沿海巡航艇，不建议作为远洋巡航船使用。此次航行体验愉快，船体和设备均无损坏，抵达夏威夷时状态良好。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：关于单人航行冒险及其准备工作的讨论

不同观点：
• LeifCarrotson认为该网站非常有趣，尤其是关于其妻子的信件以及航行中的电力管理。他指出，现代技术如太阳能板可以更有效地解决电力问题，而174瓦时的日常电力需求在今天可以通过简单的太阳能方案满足。
• _cormorant指出可能有一个与故事中描述的船只相同的船正在出售，并提供了一个出售链接。
• smithclay推荐了一本相关的书《Sailing Alone: A Surprising History of Isolation and Survival at Sea》，供对单人航行历史感兴趣的人阅读。
• medion分享了个人类似的航行经历，从Berkeley出发到Honolulu，虽然时间比预期长且遇到了一些危险，但总体顺利。
• _whiteCaps_推荐了Paul Lutus的航行书和Vic Maui比赛，为有兴趣参与航行比赛的人提供了参考。

43558077.article_content:
Chubby Commutes to Hawaii:
A Technical Discussion
By Bill Teplow
From Dream to Plan
As a consulting exploration geologist, my work life tends to consist of periods
of intense work punctuated by periods of intense unemployment. True to form,
I completed my last work assignment on July 8th and I found myself with a month
and a half of enforced leisure before my next gig. Since the coming job was
located on the Big Island of Hawaii, an old fantasy of mine started to materialize
as an actual plan. In early July, while looking at my West Wight Potter 19 "Chubby"
sitting jauntily at her berth at the Berkeley Marina, tugging at her dock lines
and proudly showing off her new bottom paint, it dawned on me that I could use
her to commute to my next job. On July 9th I started serious preparations for
the trip.
Just as I was getting heavily into the outfitting, my client on the Big Island
called and asked me to show up on July 16th at a coordinating meeting for the
project startup. I flew over to Hilo a day early and went straight to Radio
Bay, the small boat harbor located in the far eastern corner of Hilo Bay, tucked
in behind the big commercial docks. I chatted with the very friendly and accommodating
Harbor Master's staff and got all the information needed for proper check-in
and for renting a space at the harbor. I also got a chance to see the particular
style of anchoring and stern tie that is used at the 10' high cement sea wall.
The daily fee for keeping Chubby at Radio Bay is $8.50. There is a 30 day limit
that can be extended if there is room. When I arrived four weeks later in Chubby,
there were two boats tied up, leaving room for perhaps 15 more, so space was
not an issue. There is a locked restroom with shower at the dock for the exclusive
use of cruisers, and a market and laundromat one block away. The friendly atmosphere
and secure tie-up for my destination port gave me the final push to commit to
the voyage.
Upon return home to Oakland I found myself with four days to make the final
preparations for the trip. I had committed myself to a July 21 departure which
was the latest possible date that would assure my arrival in Hilo prior to start
of work. Also that date had a mild afternoon ebb to aid my escape. With such
a short period of time to prepare the boat, things got pretty hectic. But when
it came time to push back from the dock, Chubby was pretty well prepared and
upon arriving in Hilo, I was still of the same opinion.
To Reality
The following is a discussion of the technical aspects of preparing Chubby
and sailing her from Berkeley, California to Hilo, Hawaii. The actual distance
sailed was 2142 nautical miles and the voyage took 24 days, almost to the minute,
to complete. The voyage in general went very smoothly with no major mishaps.
I arrived in Hilo feeling fit, rested and happy. For those who enjoy reading
about ordeals at sea, I am sorry to disappoint. Nothing that was supplied by
International Marine, the Potter manufacturer, broke during the voyage. Chubby
generally behaved quite well in the open ocean and the trade winds even though
she is designed to be a trailer sailer and coastal pocket cruiser. I want to
stress that I do not want this article or my generally pleasant experience in
sailing Chubby to Hawaii to be construed as an endorsement for using the Potter
19 as a blue water cruiser. It was designed to be a safe and competent trailerable
coastal pocket cruiser and it fulfills its stated goals admirably.
Safety
Of the modifications I made to the otherwise stock Potter 19, most were aimed
at increasing the margin of safety for this already safe and stable design.
In order to increase the rate of drainage of the cockpit in case Chubby was
pooped, I added two additional 1-1/4" diameter cockpit drains located just
above the cockpit floor at the base of the transom. I also raised the overall
freeboard of the cabin by installing a hinged and latched lower companionway
door. Weather stripping for the door made a water-tight seal. This increased
the cabin freeboard by about 8" and raised it above the height of the transom.
Theoretically this would allow the clearing of water from the cockpit while
preventing significant volumes of water from spilling into the cabin.
I installed two types of jack lines. I ran a conventional nylon webbing jackline
around the perimeter of boat and anchored them through the fore and aft pairs
of deck cleats. The jackline was used as an anchor for my tether and harness.
The perimeter arrangement allowed me to clip into the jackline in the cockpit
and then go to the foredeck for headsail changes in my usual manner which was
to swing outboard of the shrouds. If I got bucked off the foredeck, I would
theoretically slide along the jackline to the stern and would be able to climb
aboard the boat using the swim ladder. A critical extra bit of safety equipment
for this jackline system was the tiller pilot trip line. It appeared to me that

data.title: When Jorge Luis Borges met one of the founders of AI
data.author: benbreen
data.article_summary: 无法获取文章内容
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：围绕博尔赫斯的作品及其与人工智能（LLM）关系的讨论

不同观点：
• [viccis] 推荐博尔赫斯的作品，尤其是《特隆、乌克巴尔、奥尔比斯·特蒂乌斯》和《迷宫》，并提到目前英语最佳版本是《企鹅现代作家全集》。他还讨论了博尔赫斯与LLM（大型语言模型）的关系，认为即使拥有博尔赫斯的全部阅读和感官数据，也无法创造出博尔赫斯式的先验知识，因为这涉及到康德的认识论问题。

• [karaterobot] 对LLM能否通过深入理解博尔赫斯的生活来重现其作品表示好奇，并认为这是一个有趣的创意故事，或许未来LLM可以实现这一点。

• [101008] 推荐博尔赫斯，但认为其英文翻译缺乏原作的诗意和音乐性，庆幸自己的母语是西班牙语。

• [kouru225] 推荐博尔赫斯的短篇小说《博闻强记的富内斯》，并分享了链接。

• [jhbadger] 对网站使用的图片实际上是克劳德·香农表示困惑，并提供了相关链接。

• [tekacs] 推荐了一篇关于博尔赫斯与人工智能的论文，并提供了链接。

• [jl6] 提到霍夫斯塔特应该写一本关于博尔赫斯的书，并分享了自己关于博尔赫斯与AI等主题的写作链接。

• [david_shi] 引用了博尔赫斯的《阿莱夫》中的一段文字，展示了博尔赫斯作品中的深邃意象。

• [netsharc] 认为博尔赫斯的故事有时像是在报告某种假设情境，如果这篇讨论是对博尔赫斯的致敬，那将非常有趣。

• [6stringmerc] 提到在狱中阅读萨特的《存在与虚无》，认为LLM若经过萨特作品的训练，可能会产生令人不安的逻辑推论，反映人类思想和行为的不完美状态。

• [integralof5y] 认为博尔赫斯和赫伯特·西蒙都是伟大的思想家，但他们关于人类与机器智能的对话并不深入，LLM为我们提供了探索智能与语言关系的新工具。

补充讨论：
• [mentalgear] 询问是否有该访谈的音频文件，表示更喜欢听原版内容。

争议焦点：
• 博尔赫斯作品能否通过LLM重现：[viccis]和[karaterobot]对此持不同意见，前者认为即使拥有数据也无法重现博尔赫斯的先验知识，而后者则认为这是一个有趣的潜在发展。

• 翻译问题：[101008] 认为博尔赫斯的英文翻译缺乏原作的诗意和音乐性，这引发了对翻译质量的讨论。

• 博尔赫斯与人工智能的关系：[tekacs]和[jl6]提供了相关论文和链接，扩展了博尔赫斯作品与现代AI技术的联系。

• 访谈图片错误：[jhbadger] 指出了网站图片的错误，并提供了相关链接，这涉及到对历史人物的正确识别问题。

这些讨论展示了博尔赫斯作品的多重维度和其在现代技术背景下的新意义。

data.title: Web Server for AoE 1, 2 and 3 DE supporting LAN multiplayer 100% offline
data.author: apitman
data.article_summary:
Age LAN Server 是一个支持《帝国时代》1、2、3决定版进行局域网（LAN）多人游戏的离线 web 服务器。它允许玩家在没有互联网连接的情况下进行游戏，即使官方服务器维护或关闭，LAN 功能仍可使用。该项目目前处于维护状态，仅修复错误和更新依赖项。要完全离线游玩，玩家需要自定义启动器来绕过游戏的联网限制，并可能使用 Steam 模拟器。

支持功能包括场景模式、地图传输、游戏恢复、模组支持、大厅聊天和跨平台联机（Steam 和 Xbox）。但也存在一些限制，如无法进行排名比赛、无法观战、好友列表显示所有在线用户等。此外，成就、排行榜、玩家数据等功能在离线模式下无法使用。

服务器最低系统要求包括 Windows 10、Linux kernel 2.6.32 及以上、macOS Big Sur 等，客户端则需对应游戏的特定版本。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：经典即时战略游戏《Age of Empires》（AoE）及其相关技术话题，包括游戏保存、网络对战方式、开源许可问题以及技术实现细节。

不同观点：
• Rendello推荐了一个免费的、类似于AoE的游戏0 A.D.，并附上了链接，认为该游戏对战略游戏爱好者具有吸引力。
• recycledmatt对游戏功能因服务器关闭而丢失表示遗憾，强调了游戏未来验证的重要性。
• apitman寻找通过互联网进行LAN游戏的最佳方案，提到了Hamachi和ZeroTier，倾向于开源解决方案，并对Tailscale不支持多播表示失望。
• red_admiral对AoE2在1999年发布并持续更新至2025年表示赞赏，认为其具有长久生命力。
• Seanambers回忆了2000年代LAN游戏的经历，提到游戏崩溃反而避免了失败，增加了乐趣。
• o1o1o1对Steam的便利性表示认可，但对其锁定效应表示担忧，并赞赏开源项目带来的自主权。

43562860.article_summary:
Age LAN Server 是一个支持《帝国时代》1、2、3决定版进行局域网（LAN）多人游戏的离线 web 服务器。它允许玩家在没有互联网连接的情况下进行游戏，即使官方服务器维护或关闭，LAN 功能仍可使用。该项目目前处于维护状态，仅修复错误和更新依赖项。要完全离线游玩，玩家需要自定义启动器来绕过游戏的联网限制，并可能使用 Steam 模拟器。

支持功能包括场景模式、地图传输、游戏恢复、模组支持、大厅聊天和跨平台联机（Steam 和 Xbox）。但也存在一些限制，如无法进行排名比赛、无法观战、好友列表显示所有在线用户等。此外，成就、排行榜、玩家数据等功能在离线模式下无法使用。

服务器最低系统要求包括 Windows 10、Linux kernel 2.6.32 及以上、macOS Big Sur 等，客户端则需对应游戏的特定版本。

data.title: Apple's Cubify Anything: Scaling Indoor 3D Object Detection
data.author: Tycho87
data.article_summary: 该仓库提供了Cubify Transformer的公开实现和相关的CA-1M数据集，用于室内3D物体检测。CA-1M数据集包含每个场景的类别无关3D框注释，并以激光扫描仪的坐标系发布。每个帧还包含独立于任何姿态的3D框地面真实数据、GT姿态和深度图像。数据以WebDataset格式发布，并提供基本代码以运行Cubify Transformer模型。CA-1M数据集仅包括成功注册到激光扫描仪的捕获，所有数据在CC-by-NC-ND许可证下发布，可通过`data/train.txt`和`data/val.txt`中的链接下载。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：围绕扫描房间并导出到Blender等3D工具的应用，及其相关技术实现、许可证问题和实际效果的讨论。

不同观点：
• Carrok认为，现有的扫描应用（如Scaniverse）已经接近实现他的需求，但存在问题：扫描结果是一个整体网格，无法单独操作家具（如沙发），他希望能够自由移动家具。
• pablogancharov提供了一个渲染USDZ文件的Three.js演示链接，可能对其他开发者有帮助。
• pzo批评了项目中使用的多重许可证组合，认为这使得第三方开发者难以使用，建议使用单一的严格许可证（如AGPL或CC-by-NC-ND）。
• desertmonad也指出许可证（Attribution-NonCommercial-NoDerivatives）非常限制，不利于广泛使用。
• callumprentice提到自己正在开发的equirectangular图像查看器，并分享了相关链接和示例，认为这些工具可以在现实和虚拟世界中都有很好的表现。
• syntaxing对该技术未被集成到CoreML中表示惊讶，认为这对Vision Pro等设备很有用。
• fidotron对扫描结果的精度提出质疑，认为图片中的细节（如墙上的画和天花板的梁）处理得不够好，可能无法满足大多数AR开发者的需求。
• totetsu以讽刺的口吻质疑该应用是否是为了让智能音箱更好地汇报用户家中的情况给Apple。
• Svip则以幽默的方式提到Power Mac G4 Cube，与Apple相关的"cube"概念产生联想。

补充讨论：
• 许可证问题是一个重要讨论点，多个评论提到多重许可证组合让使用变得复杂且限制较多。
• 扫描结果的精度和可操作性是另一个讨论焦点，Carrok和fidotron都提到扫描结果的细节和可编辑性问题。
• 技术实现方面，syntaxing和pablogancharov提到CoreML和Three.js等技术工具的潜在应用。

争议焦点：
• 许可证的多重性和限制性是主要争议点，开发者们对如何简化和放宽使用限制有不同看法。
• 扫描结果的精度和可操作性也是争议的焦点，部分用户对当前技术的实现效果表示不满。

CA-1M and Cubify Anything
This repository includes the public implementation of Cubify Transformer and the
associated CA-1M dataset.
Paper
Apple
Cubify Anything: Scaling Indoor 3D Object Detection
Justin Lazarow, David Griffiths, Gefen Kohavi, Francisco Crespo, Afshin Dehghan
CVPR 2025
Repository Overview
This repository includes:
Links to the underlying data and annotations of the CA-1M dataset.
Links to released models of the Cubify Transformer (CuTR) model from the Cubify Anything paper.
Basic readers and inference code to run CuTR on the provided data.
Basic support for using images captured from own device using the NeRF Capture app.
Installation
We recommend Python 3.10 and a recent 2.x build of PyTorch. We include a
requirements.txt
which should encapsulate
all necessary dependencies. Please make sure you have
torch
installed first, e.g.,:
pip install torch torchvision
Then, within the root of the repository:
pip install -r requirements.txt
pip install -e .
CA-1M versus ARKitScenes?
This work is related to
ARKitScenes
. We generally share
the same underlying captures. Some notable differences in CA-1M:
Each scene has been exhaustively annotated with class-agnostic 3D boxes. We release these in the laser scanner's coordinate frame.
For each frame in each capture, we include "per-frame" 3D box ground-truth which was produced using the rendering
process outlined in the Cubify Anything paper. These annotations are, therefore,
independent
of any pose.
Some other nice things:
We release the GT poses (registered to laser scanner) for every frame in each capture.
We release the GT depth (rendered from laser scanner) at 512 x 384 for every frame in each capture.
Each frame has been already oriented into an upright position.
NOTE:
CA-1M will only include captures which were successfully registered to the laser scanner. Therefore
not every capture including in ARKitScenes will be present in CA-1M.
Downloading and using the CA-1M data
Data License
All data is released under the
CC-by-NC-ND
.
All links to the data are contained in
data/train.txt
and
data/val.txt
. You can use
curl
to download all files
listed. If you don't need the whole dataset in advance, you can either explicitly pass these
links explicitly or pass the split's
txt
file itself and use the
--video-ids
argument to filter the desired videos.
If you pass the
txt
file, please note that file will be cached under
data/[split]
.
Understanding the CA-1M data
CA-1M is released in WebDataset format. Therefore, it is essentially a fancy tar archive
per
capture (i.e., a video). Therefore, a single archive
ca1m-[split]-XXXXXXX.tar
corresponds to all data
of capture XXXXXXXX.
Both splits are released at full frame rate.
All data should be neatly loaded by
CubifyAnythingDataset
. Please refer to
dataset.py
for more
specifics on how to read/parse data on disk. Some general pointers:

data.author: namanyayg
data.article_summary: The Classic 2是经典款的升级版，售价144加元起，保留了原版大部分设计，同时在几个关键方面进行了改进。它将原版的USB-B接口升级为更现代的USB-C接口，提高了连接的便捷性和耐用性。针对原版滚轮在快速转动时出现的异常问题，Classic 2采用了更强大的Raspberry RP2040微控制器，使滚轮响应更快、更精准。外观和手感与原版保持一致，但优化了3D打印的便利性，去除了不必要的支撑结构。硬件方面，依然采用高性能的PMW-3360光学传感器和D2LS-21开关。Classic 2设计继续保持开源，提供完整文档，但无法从原版升级。原版将下架，但会继续提供维护支持。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：不同用户对轨迹球鼠标的偏好、使用体验及其设计和开源性的讨论。

不同观点：
• donatj：喜欢使用所有手指操作的大球体轨迹球，认为仅用拇指操作可能导致重复性劳损（RSI）。他还指出，不应将轨迹球称为“Trackball Mouse”，就像不应将触控板称为“Trackpad Mouse”一样。
• Abishek_Muthian：由于手腕畸形和小手掌（侏儒症），尝试过多种鼠标后，最终选择Logitech Ergo M575轨迹球鼠标，并认为这对有可访问性需求的人非常有帮助。他欢迎更多像Ploopy这样的开源硬件竞争者，因为定制化对于可访问性至关重要。
• vlowther：怀念Trackman Marble FX，认为其设计优雅且使用方便，没有找到其他能与之媲美的轨迹球设计。
• _fat_santa：认为这些鼠标不适合自己，但对产品开源性表示赞赏，认为开源设计可能有助于增加销售。虽然起初对144美元的价格感到惊讶，但考虑到自行制作的成本，认为这个价格合理。

补充讨论：
• reassess_blind：询问是否有人在笔记本电脑上使用轨迹球鼠标，尤其是在沙发上使用时的体验以及轻度游戏的表现。
• OuterVale：由于原网站访问量过大而无法访问，提供了Wayback Machine的存档链接。
• mfro：认为Ploopy的鼠标与已停产的Protoarc EM03非常相似，后者是他用过的最好的轨迹球，目前正在联系Protoarc了解其网店页面下线的原因。
• jaffa2：询问轨迹球鼠标是使用拇指还是手指控制，并表示自己更喜欢中央球体设计。
• idahoduncan：赞赏Ploopy设计和制造开源硬件，拥有Ploopy的Classic (1) 轨迹球，并认为其新推出的触控板更适合自己，支持多指手势操作。
• tombert：询问轨迹球鼠标在像Arkanoid或Breakout这样的游戏中的表现如何，表示自己从未习惯使用鼠标或触控板玩这些游戏。
• onemoresoop：由于数据库连接错误而无法访问网站。
• dwighttk：质疑该文章是否会成为双周刊发布。

争议焦点：
• 不同用户对轨迹球鼠标设计和操作方式的偏好不同，例如donatj和jaffa2更喜欢中央大球体设计，而Abishek_Muthian和_fat_santa则对特定品牌和型号的轨迹球鼠标有不同看法。

43522060.article_content:
The Classic 2 is a brand new revision of the original Classic, and kits are available today starting at
$144CAD
!
The Classic 2 is just like the original in every way that matters. It’s also a major upgrade for the few things that needed tweaking.
Check out the shop
USB-C connector
That’s right, the Classic 2 has a USB-C connector!
The original Classic has a bulky USB-B connector on it (if you don’t know, it’s the connector that you often find in printers). USB-B connectors are very mechanically strong, a quality we prioritised for the purposes of longevity.
Since we launched the original Classic, we’ve been shipping many devices with USB-C connectors. We’ve shown to ourselves that these connectors are just as reliable and strong as USB-B connectors.
So, yes – the Classic 2 will have a USB-C connector on it, and it’ll be just as mechanically strong as the connector on the original Classic.
An improved scroll wheel
A common issue with the original Classic was that the scroll wheel would often act oddly if spun too quickly, or would sometimes reverse direction unexpectedly. This issue arose from the way the scroll wheel works.
Want the gory technical details? Expand to find out more.
The scroll wheel operates using something called a “binary Gray code”.
The binary Gray code is simply a way of seeing the direction in which something is moving. If you’ve ever been to a parking garage that has a parking space counter, it’s usually implemented as a binary Gray code.
The way it works is that two lasers are positioned at the entrance to the garage. If, for example, a car breaks the first beam and then the second, the garage’s software knows that a car is entering. If the second beam is broken and then the first, a car is leaving. Our scroll wheel is implemented in a very similar way.
The scroll wheel design uses a phototransistor to detect the “laser” (which is actually an infrared photodiode, in our case). The microcontroller polls the phototransistor to see if it’s detecting any light.
And this is the key problem: the detection poll. The microcontroller in the original Classic is very, very slow. It runs at just 8MHz, which means that if the scroll wheel is spun too quickly, the microcontroller can’t keep up.
In our parking garage analogy, it’s as if multiple cars pass through the laser beams very fast. If the garage’s software is too slow, it’ll think only one car entered the garage. That’s exactly what’s happening in our scroll wheel, since the microcontroller is too slow.
The good news is that we put a new microcontroller in the Classic 2: the Raspberry RP2040. This new microcontroller runs the scroll wheel algorithms fifteen times faster than the one in the original Classic.
The result is crisp, accurate scrolling without any spinouts or unexpected reversals.
Same great shape and performance, with improved printability
The ergonomics of the original Classic were something that we really worked hard on, and many people agree that it works well. Because of that, we didn’t change the ergonomics, at all.
The Classic 2 has exactly the same shape. We promise – we didn’t mess with it in the slightest!
We did, however, change it to make it more printable. The original Classic had some odd overhangs and support material requirements that we’ve worked out of the design.
So, now, the same great ergonomic shape should roll off your printer much more smoothly than before.
We also kept all of the high-performance harware inside. The Classic 2 still has the great PMW-3360 optical sensor for unparalleled accuracy, and still uses great D2LS-21 switches for fantastic clicks.
learn more
And… still open-source
Of course, the entire Classic 2 design is open-source, under the CERN OHL license for the hardware and GPL for the firmware.
We’ve also released full assembly documentation and everything you’d need to build a kit, repair it, make one yourself, or mod it.
Go to the Github Repository
Thanks to everyone in our community!
We’re excited to share this with you, and we hope that the Classic 2 will serve this community well. We’re looking forward to seeing your builds and mods in the future!
Stay in touch with us!
Reddit
Mastodon
GitHub
Mail
Frequently Asked Questions
Do you have an upgrade kit so I can upgrade my original Classic to a Classic 2?
Unfortunately, no. The original Classic PCBs weren’t designed to be upgraded at a later date, so it’s not possible to swap in the new components for the old ones. Additionally, almost all of the plastic parts have been updated, so the Classic 2 parts aren’t compatible with the original Classic.
Will you continue selling original Classic kits?
No, the original Classic design will be retired from our shop.
Will you continue providing maintenance kits for the original Classic?
Yes! We will continue providing support in the form of maintenance kits to everybody who supported us by purchasing an original Classic kit.
Is there a left-handed version of the Classic 2?
No, and we’re not actively

data.title: Search could be so much better. And I don't mean chatbots with web access
data.author: mfkhalil
data.article_summary: 文章介绍了一种新型搜索引擎MatterRank，其核心特点是让用户能够控制搜索结果的排序，而不仅仅是让算法猜测用户的需求。传统的搜索引擎通过关键词、链接和各种信号来猜测用户意图，而MatterRank允许用户用自己的语言描述如何排序结果，提供更个性化和精准的搜索体验。这不是一个简单的聊天机器人或智能自动补全工具，而是一种全新的搜索方式，让用户决定什么最重要。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：搜索引擎的使用体验和功能改进

不同观点：
• [q0uaur] 认为该搜索引擎的概念不错，但怀疑其每次查询的成本较高。测试时要求排除大科技公司和广告，但结果中仍出现YouTube和Reddit，质疑算法是否真正过滤了域名。
• [maximumgeek] 批评该帖缺乏上下文，认为搜索结果仍需改进，尤其是广告和无用结果的过滤问题。对Quora答案和此类宣传帖感到厌烦。
• [SteveDavis88] 希望有一个能严格按照指定关键词返回结果的搜索引擎，认为谷歌无法满足这一点。
• [renegat0x0] 讨论了使用大型SQLite数据库进行域名搜索的可能性，但承认面临垃圾信息和过滤的挑战，类似于谷歌的处理方式。
• [danpalmer] 不同意搜索引擎假设用户不知道自己想要什么的说法，认为这是对搜索引擎体验的误解。
• [mfkhalil] 支持使用MatterRank，认为其能提供超越关键词匹配的定性特征结果，例如特定内容过滤，提供更高的搜索精度。
• [AymanJabr] 批评需要注册和创建引擎的步骤，希望直接使用搜索功能，不关心保存引擎供日后使用。
• [karmakaze] 质疑该帖是否为宣传广告，认为缺乏技术内容，未解释为何MatterRank优于Perplexity。
• [janalsncm] 认为使用LLM（大型语言模型）进行排名虽然结果质量较高，但速度较慢，建议通过过滤低质量内容和使用神经网络提高速度。
• [BrenBarn] 认为不仅是搜索引擎，现代技术普遍存在告诉用户该做什么的趋势，而非让用户自主决定。
• [eternauta3k] 质疑在每个结果上运行LLM的成本是否过高。
• [vivzkestrel] 提出Kagi与MatterRank的比较问题。
• [skeptrune] 询问是否存在某种交叉编码器用于评分提示。
• [TekMol] 坚决反对需要创建账户才能使用搜索引擎的做法。

补充讨论：
• 搜索结果的质量和相关性是主要关注点，尤其是广告和低质量内容的过滤。
• 用户普遍对需要注册或创建账户的搜索引擎持负面态度。
• 不同用户对LLM的使用持不同看法，有人认为能提高结果质量，有人认为速度太慢。
• 对MatterRank的功能和优势存在争议，部分用户质疑其宣传效果。
• 比较不同搜索引擎（如Kagi和MatterRank）的讨论显示用户对搜索引擎的选择和偏好存在差异。

43563915.article_content:
Search could be so much better
And I don't mean chatbots with access to a search engine.
Search is suffering from a quiet, unfortunate assumption. One that made the internet accessible to billions—but made it much less personal than it could be.
It assumes we don't know what we want.
This isn't search engines' fault. For decades, the only way we could communicate what we wanted was through a little search box.
So they did their best. They built systems to guess what we meant—ranking pages based on overlapping words, backlinks, reputation, and a hundred other signals. The best version of that became PageRank. And it was so good, it powered one of the most valuable companies in history.
But then computers learned how to understand language.
Now, we can do something new: we can tell search engines not just what we want, but
how we want it ranked
.
MatterRank is the first search engine where you control the ranking—using your own words.
This isn't a chatbot that summarizes results. And it's not just smarter autocomplete.
It's a new kind of search engine—one that lets you decide what matters most.
Let me know what you uncover. My email's below.
—Moe Khalil
Founder of MatterRank
moe@matterrank.ai
Try it now!
...or read more about how it works
→

data.title: Calibrated Basic Income by Derek Van Gorder [pdf]
data.author: Suncho
data.article_summary: 无法获取文章内容
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：全民基本收入（UBI）的可行性、资金来源及其对社会和经济的影响

不同观点：
• [notepad0x90] 认为讨论UBI时应排除情绪化因素，核心问题应是UBI是否是税收资金的最佳使用方式。他强调需要数据和研究来证明UBI的有效性，并提出一种替代方案，即建立劳动储备池，让有劳动能力的人为国家工作以换取保障收入。

• [jimnotgym] 将UBI视为一种货币政策工具，认为它比量化宽松（QE）更直接有效地刺激经济，因为低收入家庭更可能迅速花费收到的UBI资金，从而促进消费。

• [mertbio] 质疑UBI在当前高租金情况下的有效性，提出“全民基本土地”（Universal Basic Land）作为替代方案，认为提供土地比提供收入更能解决问题。

• [veltas] 担心UBI会加剧通货膨胀，特别是对穷人的影响。他认为债务对年轻人和贫困背景的人是有益的，并质疑UBI是否真的能改善穷人的经济状况，而不是伤害他们。

• [rspoerri] 支持现有的政府补贴制度，并认为扩展到其他基本权利可以预防未来的社会问题，强调基本的生活需求应作为基本权利得到保障。

• [KolmogorovComp] 引用了一种通过货币政策收缩来资助UBI的理论，担心如果UBI金额过低（如10美元），在经济紧缩时期可能无法有效实施。

• [dwighttk] 质疑UBI的资金来源，以阿拉斯加通过出售石油实现UBI为例，提出其他地区如何实现UBI的问题。

• [throw0101b] 引用了Luke Martinelli的论文，提出了UBI在可负担性、充分性和简化福利政策之间的三难选择，认为部分UBI可能是更可行的方案。

• [6510] 支持从低金额开始实施UBI，以收集实际数据和实施经验。

• [bsenftner] 强烈反对UBI，认为它会毒害宏观经济，固化社会阶层，消除经济上升的可能性，是“希望的死亡”。

data.title: Reintroducing Capsul
data.author: j3s
data.article_summary: Capsul起源自cyberia.club，最初名为CVM（Cyberia Virtual Machines），通过手工创建虚拟机并收费。服务器“Baikal”因其深层含义而得名，并在初期运行良好。随着Forest开发了自助网页界面，CVM更名为Capsul。由于硬件问题，团队曾赴亚特兰大修复服务器。在遭遇Stripe支付中断后，Capsul从Cyberia独立出来，由新成立的Break Software LLC运营。2025年，新服务器Rathouse上线，团队计划通过改进性能和功能，使Capsul成为更优质、易用的小型云服务，而非简单的租赁平台。未来发展仍在不断推进中。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：围绕共享服务器、网页设计质量以及开源问题的讨论

不同观点：
• [ydnaclementine] 认为每个黑客空间都应该有一个共享服务器，并以自己大学的开源俱乐部为例，说明这种共享资源对成员学习和实验的重要性。同时表达了对没有更多参与相关活动的遗憾。

• [Simorgh] 对链接页面的用户体验（UX）设计表示赞赏，特别提到其视觉效果、色彩运用以及易于理解的特性，认为该网站在设计上非常大胆且具有吸引力。

• [pomatic] 关注虚拟机（VM）供应前端是否开源，明确表示不是为了复制业务，而是寻找一个可以进行实验的供应框架，并对Proxmox等现有方案提出了不满，认为其后台调整不够灵活。

补充讨论：
• [ydnaclementine] 的评论强调了实践和参与社区活动的重要性，特别是在技术学习和应用中的价值。
• [Simorgh] 侧重于对网页设计的审美和用户体验的评价，突显了设计在吸引用户和提升使用体验中的作用。
• [pomatic] 则更关心技术实现的细节和开源解决方案的可操作性，尤其是对现有工具的局限性提出了具体看法。

争议焦点：
• 虽然评论之间没有直接的争议，但[pomatic]对开源和可操作性的关注暗示了对专有或不够灵活工具的不满，这与其他评论中对开源和共享资源的积极态度形成了一定对比。

43534381.article_content:
reintroducing capsul
29 Mar, 2025
capsul
has a rich history. born through
cyberia.club
, our first server was literally cobbled together on the rooftop of my apartment complex. about 10 of us were there, perhaps a little drunk, and we covered the first 1u server in stickers. it's still around the clubhouse at
layer zero
- we named the server "baikal", after the deepest lake in the world, and a joke on "cyberia" sounding like "siberia". here is a picture of baikal from back then:
when capsul started, it wasn't even called capsul - it was called "cvm", which stood for "cyberia virtual machines".
i created virtual machines for people by hand with a small set of shell scripts, and those people paid me in cash. cvm was cool like that - covert, human, and communal. i'd take 60 bux, write it down in a spreadsheet, and spin up a VM.
some vms still have a
cvm-
prefix internally.
eventually,
forest
came along and blessed cvm with a self-service web interface. at this point, we renamed cvm to capsul. it took forest about a week to pump out capsul v1, which looked like this:
baikal + capsul ran many virtual machines for many people for nearly five years, with only a few minor mishaps along the way.
well, except...
atlanta
one time, the disks in baikal were basically about to explode themselves
, and we were too embarassed ask the
CyberWurx
datacenter staff to try to help us fix it remotely after we had mailed them two different PCI-E SSD risers that didn't fit in the server chassis. So we had to fly to Atlanta (where baikal was in a rack at CyberWurx) to fix them. forest and i made a little trip of it:
in the end, we prevailed. we prevented a critical storage mishap, and baikal lived on for another several years.
EPIC emergency server migration 🤯
baikal (our old server) could no longer handle the load, was constantly crashing
rathouse (our NEW server) was already racked up and ready to go
we wanted to wait until we could get backups working on the new system before we migrated... but real life had other plans for us
capsul was fully down for about a day and a half
stripe doomsday
stripe cut off our credit card payments because the cyberia computer club's minnesota nonprofit status had lapsed after everyone who was doing the work of maintaining it faded away.
we had been the ones maintaining capsul for many years at that point, and in 2023, cyberia congress
officially released
capsul to be owned by us instead of being owned by the club.
so in order to get stripe payments working again, we "failed forward" and created a new legal entity that will be responsible for operating capsul:
break software llc
future
okay, so it's 2025. we recently installed a new server (rathouse), and have renewed energy for this project. forest and i are getting more serious about trying to make capsul a real thing.
we've been talking with great folks around various smallweb communities -- the kind of folks capsul was originally created for, and who we still want to offer a great service to. it's always been like this; we use capsul ourselves, and our own wants and needs as admins of an
independent community-hosting project
have guided capsul's development:
we needed better storage performance to make our chat server happy, so we adjusted the storage settings to speed up our disk reads and writes as much as possible.
we still wanted to be able to back up and restore our VMs, so we integrated
virtnbdbackup
directly into capsul.
we want to make capsul the best lil cloud there is. not just another 5$/month rent seeking project;  a genuinely better option which is more accessible, more fun, and still has the power and reliability to be much more than a toy.
we gave capsul a CSS makeover, a light theme, fixed some longstanding bugs, and updated all of our OS images, and we have a lot of ideas, but they're still baking.
if you wanna say hi, you can always send us email at
support@capsul.org
-- otherwise, we're always hanging out in
matrix
. :)
i'll try to post here at least monthly.
see you soon <3 <3 <3
love,
j3s
,
forest
10

data.title: Aptera's First Solar Road Trip. 300 Miles, One Charge
data.author: geox
data.article_summary: Aptera成功完成了其首次太阳能支持的公路旅行，单次充电行驶超过300英里，展示了太阳能电动车不仅是未来概念，更是当前可行的解决方案。这趟旅程从亚利桑那州的弗拉格斯塔夫出发，经过历史悠久的66号公路，途经金曼和哈瓦苏湖，最终返回加州。尽管有些时候是多云天气，车辆仍能产生超过545瓦的太阳能输入。车辆在各种路况下表现优异，包括山路、高速公路和乡村道路。此次旅行不仅验证了Aptera系统在现实条件下的可靠性，还展示了重新思考交通工具的潜力。为了庆祝这次成功，Aptera还举办了一项抽奖活动，奖品包括价值800美元的太阳能套装。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：电动汽车（EV）上安装太阳能板的实用性及可行性，特别是Aptera车型的设计和生产问题。

不同观点：
• 支持太阳能板在EV上的应用：
  - [torginus] 认为在EV上安装太阳能板非常实用，即使只能产生几百瓦的电力，也能满足日常通勤需求，减少插电次数。
  - [ZeroGravitas] 指出太阳能板在某些特定领域（如冷藏车、高尔夫球车）已经得到应用，并且未来有增长潜力。

• 对Aptera车型及生产问题的关注：
  - [arrakark] 赞赏Aptera的愿景，但对车型的量产能力和资金问题表示担忧。
  - [underseacables] 表示对Aptera的喜爱，但认为像BYD和Tesla这样的公司会占据大部分市场份额，且Aptera在融资方面遇到了困难。

• 对太阳能板效率和设计的质疑：
  - [pinkmuffinere] 通过计算质疑太阳能板在实际使用中的效率，认为即使在理想条件下，所产生的电量也不足以支持长距离行驶。
  - [dontlaugh] 对Aptera车身尺寸和设计提出质疑，认为其过大。
  - [dscottboggs] 强烈反对在EV上安装太阳能板，认为这不仅增加成本，且无法支持车辆在实际道路条件下的行驶需求。

• 其他创新设计建议：
  - [xnx] 提出了一种替代方案，即使用拖挂式太阳能板，以增加太阳能发电量并适用于任何EV。

• 历史案例的提及：
  - [jore] 提到了德国初创公司Sono Motors的类似项目，虽然该公司已经破产，但其太阳能板项目仍在继续。

• 对市场接受度的讨论：
  - [mlsu] 认为Aptera这样的高效能汽车虽然设计优美，但市场接受度可能不高，因为大多数消费者更关注价格和实用性。

• 对特朗普和马斯克曾提出的太阳能车顶概念的讨论：
  - [trhway] 分析了Trump和Musk曾提出的太阳能车顶概念，认为如果成本接近零，这种设计对日常通勤是有意义的，但目前实现起来成本过高。

补充讨论：
- 评论中多次提到Aptera的生产和资金问题，反映出对该车型能否成功量产的普遍担忧。
- 对太阳能板在实际应用中的效率问题进行了详细计算和分析，显示出对其实用性的质疑。
- 有人提出创新的设计方案，如拖挂式太阳能板，以解决现有设计中的效率问题。

43533556.article_content:
300+ Miles, One Charge, Supported by the Sun’s Rays
Aptera just completed its first-ever solar-supported road trip—driving over 300 miles on a single charge and proving that a solar EV isn’t just a concept for the future, but a real-world solution ready for the present.
Our Co-CEO Steve Fambro, along with a small crew, took Aptera’s production-intent vehicle on a road trip through the American Southwest. They started early in the snowy mountain town of Flagstaff, Arizona, where the vehicle was already pulling in 300 watts of solar energy before the day even began.
The route followed a stretch of historic Route 66—quiet roads, breathtaking scenery, and a test bed for a vehicle built to thrive independently. “It’s kind of the path not really taken,” Steve shared. “And that’s one of the reasons we wanted to do it this way.”
From Flagstaff to Hackberry, through Kingman and down to sunny Lake Havasu, Aptera performed with quiet confidence. Even on an overcast day, the team saw over 545 watts of solar input. That means more time exploring and less time searching for chargers.
During its 300+ mile journey, the vehicle handled every condition thrown at it: mountain passes, 18-wheelers, potholes, desert winds, highways, and winding country roads.
“The panoramic windshield gives you this incredible view of the landscape,” Steve said, describing the drive. “It’s like a big picture window into the future.”
The final stretch took the team back into California, where they reflected on the journey, the data, and the excited reactions from drivers who caught a glimpse of the vehicle on the road. “Almost everyone we passed had their phones out filming us,” Steve laughed. “It’s clear that Aptera’s design stops traffic—without needing to stop for a charge.”
This trip marks a huge milestone for Aptera, not only in validating our systems in real-world conditions but in showing what’s possible when you rethink transportation from the ground up. With every mile driven by our production-intent vehicles, we’re one step closer to a future where every journey is powered by the sun.

data.title: .NET library MassTransit going commercial with V9
data.author: 8-prime
data.article_summary: MassTransit宣布推出v9版本，并转向商业许可模式。这一变化旨在确保项目的长期可持续性、持续创新和提供企业级支持。MassTransit v8将继续保持开源，并提供安全补丁和关键错误修复。v9版本将引入新功能和性能增强，通过商业许可提供，并针对不同规模的组织提供支持计划。过渡计划包括2025年Q3发布v9预览版，2026年Q1正式发布。现有v8用户可继续使用，也可选择商业支持和v9的创新功能。具体价格和更多细节将在后续公布。
data.comments_summary:

- 一些用户对转向商业许可持理解态度，认为作者需要收入来源，同时也有用户希望有可行的开源替代方案。
- 实际使用中，部分开发者表示直接使用其他消息服务，不受MassTransit转向商业许可的影响。

43565690.article_content:
Announcing MassTransit v9
A New Era for Enterprise Messaging
For over a decade, MassTransit has been the leading open-source .NET messaging framework, trusted by thousands developers and enterprises worldwide to build
scalable, distributed applications. It has facilitated billions of transactions, powered mission-critical systems in finance, healthcare, government, and
logistics, and seamlessly integrated with cloud platforms like Microsoft Azure, AWS, and Google Cloud. As adoption has surged and enterprise demand has grown,
MassTransit has evolved into a cornerstone of modern event-driven architectures. Today, we’re excited to share an important milestone!
Update - post announcement Q&A added
below
We are transitioning to a commercial model.
With MassTransit v9, we are transitioning to a commercial licensing model. This change ensures long-term sustainability, continued innovation, and
enterprise-grade support — while leaving MassTransit v8 open-source and available to the community.
Why the Change?
When MassTransit first started in 2007, it was a single assembly that supported MSMQ. Fast-forward to today, and MassTransit has extensive support for several
message brokers, multiple databases, powerful capabilities including saga state machines, job consumers, message scheduling, and routing slips, as well as its
own SQL-based message transport. The entire solution builds and deploys over thirty NuGet packages.
Because of its extensive capabilities, MassTransit has grown into a mission-critical foundation for organizations worldwide. Trusted by enterprises in more than
100 countries across industries including finance, healthcare, logistics, and government. As adoption has surged, so has the need for:
Dedicated, full-time development resources to enhance and maintain the platform.
Enterprise-grade support and guarantees for business-critical applications.
A sustainable, long-term funding model to drive continuous innovation.
By making v9 a commercial release, we can accelerate MassTransit’s evolution, delivering even better scalability, security, and performance — while continuing
to support the existing community.
Change is Hard, Why Now?
We know that change — especially in the open-source world — can be challenging. If you’ve been relying on MassTransit as a free and open solution, you might be
wondering what this shift means for you and your team. We want to be clear: we deeply appreciate the community that has helped make MassTransit what it is
today. This decision wasn’t made lightly, but rather with the long-term success and sustainability of the project in mind.
By moving to a commercial model for v9, we’re ensuring that MassTransit can continue to evolve, with dedicated resources, faster development cycles, and the
enterprise support that many organizations have been asking for. MassTransit v8 remains open-source, and we’re committed to making this transition as smooth
as possible. Our goal isn’t to take something away — but to build something even better, with the stability and support that businesses need. We’re here to
help, and we welcome your questions, feedback, and thoughts as we move forward together.
What This Means for You
MassTransit v8 Remains Open Source
The existing v8 codebase will remain open-source and available under its current license.
Security patches and critical bug fixes will continue for a transition period.
Community support remains available for v8 users.
MassTransit v9 Becomes a Commercial Product
New features, performance enhancements, and enterprise-focused capabilities will be exclusive to v9.
Available via a commercial license with support plans tailored for organizations of all sizes, including rates for independent software vendors and
consultants building and
supporting their own customer applications using MassTransit.
Expert assistance, SLAs, and long-term stability guarantees for enterprise users.
The Transition Plan
Moving to a commercial product is a huge undertaking, and the initial target dates for the transition are outlined below (and are subject to change).
Date
Milestone
Q3 2025
MassTransit v9 prerelease packages available to early adopters.
Q1 2026
MassTransit v9 official release under a commercial license.
Ongoing
MassTransit v8 security patches and community support continue.
After 2026
End of official maintenance for MassTransit v8.
How Do I Prepare?
If you're currently using MassTransit v8:
You can continue using v8 with no changes — it's open-source and will remain available.
If you need commercial support,
support agreements
are available.
If you want access to v9 and future innovations, consider our commercial licensing options (to be announced at a later date).
If you currently have a support agreement:
You will be granted a license for MassTransit v9 through the remainder of your support period.
Support will continue for your existing MassTransit v8 applications.

data.title: Training AI Using 'Pirated' Content Can Be Fair Use, Law Professors Argue
data.author: isaacfrond
data.article_summary: 文章主要讨论了Meta等科技公司在训练大型语言模型（LLMs）时，使用未授权的版权内容作为训练数据是否构成合理使用（fair use）的争议。Meta面临多位作者的集体诉讼，指控其通过BitTorrent下载盗版书籍用于训练AI。作者们认为，未经许可复制盗版书籍不属于合理使用。然而，一组知识产权法学教授提交了一份“法庭之友”简报，支持Meta的合理使用辩护。他们指出，将书籍内容用于创建新的、具有变革性的AI模型，属于合理使用，因为这种使用是“非表达性使用”（non-expressive use），并且具有变革性。教授们强调，法院应关注知识和表达的后果，而不应阻碍新技术的发展。尽管上传盗版内容可能是案件的核心争议，但简报主要针对书籍作为训练输入的合理使用问题。文章最后提到，其他国家已为训练AI创建版权例外，美国也应考虑类似措施。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：围绕使用盗版内容和公平使用（Fair Use）原则的合法性与道德性讨论，特别是在大公司利用盗版内容训练AI模型的情况下，个人是否也可以效仿，以及现行知识产权法（IP law）的合理性。

不同观点：
• [gherard5555] 认为如果大公司可以盗版内容来训练他们的模型，那么个人也有权这么做，以此来“训练自己的大脑”。这一观点具有讽刺意味，质疑大公司行为的合法性和道德性。

• [seydor] 提出质疑：以“教育目的”观看盗版电影是否也属于公平使用？这一观点引出了对公平使用原则适用范围的探讨，并要求明确合理的解释。

• [SR2Z] 支持传统公平使用原则，认为公平使用与获取方式无关，只与使用方式有关。此观点强调了公平使用是一种事后的法律辩护。

• [captainbland] 批评大公司利用版权材料牟取巨额利润，却声称是公平使用。这一观点讽刺了大公司利用法律漏洞，而不支付版权费用。

• [8-prime] 虽然不完全反对盗版，但认为以公平使用为借口进行盗版是牵强的。他强调使用版权材料进行创新和教育是合理的，但大公司不付费而声称公平使用是不恰当的。

• [nonrandomstring] 从根本上质疑知识产权法的合理性，认为其是丑陋、不公平和阻碍进步的。他主张彻底改革或废除现行知识产权法，并用“强制控制信息”（CCI）来描述当前的版权和专利制度，指出这些法律已成为有钱人的工具，而非保护个体创作者。

补充讨论：
• 争议焦点在于大公司和个人在使用盗版内容时是否可以同样主张公平使用，以及现行知识产权法是否公平有效地保护了创作者。
• 讨论还涉及知识产权法的历史根源和其演变为“强制控制信息”的现状，呼吁对法律进行重大改革或废除。
• 个人与大公司在使用版权材料上的双重标准也是一个重要讨论点，尤其是大公司利用法律漏洞而牟利的情况。

43566245.article_content:
Training AI Using ‘Pirated’ Content Can Be Fair Use, Law Professors Argue
In the race to build the most capable LLMs, several tech companies have sourced copyrighted content for use as training data, without obtaining permission from content owners.
Many of those companies are now being sued for alleged copyright infringement. The list includes Meta, which faces a class action lawsuit filed by authors Richard Kadrey, Sarah Silverman, and Christopher Golden, among others.
This case has a clear piracy angle, as Meta used BitTorrent to download archives of pirated books to use as training material. Notably, the authors argue that, in addition to copying pirated books from Anna’s Archive and Z-Library, in the same process Meta also uploaded pirated books to third parties.
Last month, both parties filed motions for summary judgment. Meta’s motion relied heavily on a fair use defense. Meanwhile, the authors argued that the downloading of millions of books cannot be classified as fair use, since the source of the books is clearly copyright infringing.
“The uncontroversial implication is that for fair use to apply, the work that was copied must have been lawfully acquired in the first place,” the authors wrote.
IP Professors Back Meta’s Fair Use Argument
This week, a group of IP Law Professors submitted a “
friend of the court
” or amicus brief, backing Meta’s fair use defense. The professors, including scholars from Harvard, Emory, Boston University, and Santa Clara University, have different views on the impact of AI but are united in their copyright stance.
The Profs
The brief stresses that Meta’s alleged use of pirated books as training data can be considered fair use. The source of the training data is not determinative, as long as it’s used to create a new and transformative product, they argue.
“The case law, including binding circuit precedent, holds that internal copying, made in the course of creating new knowledge, is a transformative use that is heavily favored by fair use doctrine,” the professors write.
Transformative Use: Piracy or Not
The professors’ argument is centered around the concept of “transformative use.” They note that using books outside their original ‘reading’ purpose to create an AI model, transforms the purpose of the use. This internal copying, they argue, falls into a category courts have consistently recognized as fair use, also known as “non-expressive use”.
The amicus brief cites several cases to back up their line of reasoning. This includes the
Perfect 10 v. Amazon
lawsuit, where the Ninth Circuit found that it was fair use when Google created thumbnails using images copied from unauthorized “pirate” sites, because the resulting image search tool was transformative.
Pirate thumbnails
The authors cited conflicting cases, but the professors note that cases where fair use was denied typically involved copyright infringement related to personal consumption, rather than use of content to create something new.
The brief distinguishes this case from those cited by the plaintiffs, which involved unauthorized copying for direct consumptive use (e.g., downloading for personal enjoyment). In contrast, Meta’s internal copies were allegedly not perceived by humans but used to build a new tool.
“Fair use, like copyright as a whole, ‘is not a privilege reserved for the well behaved’,” the brief notes. “Fair use doctrine should focus on the consequences of a ruling for knowledge and expression. Other considerations should be left for other legal regimes.”
The professors’ comments appear to relate to Meta’s internal use of the books, as training material for LLMs. It’s worth noting, however, that the authors also accuse Meta of
uploading these books
to other file-sharers while obtaining their own copies.
The amicus brief doesn’t address this issue directly, but previous
back-and-forths
in court showed that uploading is likely to be a central point of contention as the case moves forward.
‘Copyright Infringement Is Not the Answer’
The amicus brief is mostly targeted at the potential use of books as training input, which Meta and other companies publicly acknowledged. Whether this is fair use is a key question that this and other courts have to decide.
Other countries, including Japan, have reportedly crafted exceptions in their law to allow tech companies to train LLMs on copyrighted material, without permission.
The U.S. has no such exceptions, but the professors urge the court to consider fair use. As the VCR and other innovations showed, copyright shouldn’t stand in the way of new tools and developing technologies.
“Copyright owners have often predicted that new technologies, from photocopying to home VCRs to the internet, would create disasters for copyright owners and that fair use needed to be shrunk to protect them; instead, new technologies have routinely created
new markets,” they write.

• [captainbland] 批评大公司利用版权材料牟取巨额利润，却声称是公平使用。这一观点讽刺了大公司利用法律漏洞，而不支付版权费用。

• [8-prime] 虽然不完全反对盗版，但认为以公平使用为借口进行盗版是牵强的。他强调使用版权材料进行创新和教育是合理的，但大公司不付费而声称公平使用是不恰当的。

• [nonrandomstring] 从根本上质疑知识产权法的合理性，认为其是丑陋、不公平和阻碍进步的。他主张彻底改革或废除现行知识产权法，并用“强制控制信息”（CCI）来描述当前的版权和专利制度，指出这些法律已成为有钱人的工具，而非保护个体创作者。

补充讨论：
• 争议焦点在于大公司和个人在使用盗版内容时是否可以同样主张公平使用，以及现行知识产权法是否公平有效地保护了创作者。
• 讨论还涉及知识产权法的历史根源和其演变为“强制控制信息”的现状，呼吁对法律进行重大改革或废除。
• 个人与大公司在使用版权材料上的双重标准也是一个重要讨论点，尤其是大公司利用法律漏洞而牟利的情况。

data.title: Space Debris: Is It a Crisis?
data.author: defrost
data.article_summary: 这篇文章围绕太空碎片问题以及欧洲空间局的相关努力展开。内容涵盖了关于太空碎片的各种报道、视频和图片，介绍了太空垃圾的现状、影响及应对措施。此外，文章还包括多个专题聚焦和推荐内容，涉及保护地球等环境问题。页面还提供了常见问题解答、联系方式、条款与条件、隐私声明，以及欧洲空间局的职业机会和订阅信息。整体强调了对太空环境和地球保护的重视。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：太空垃圾（空间碎片）问题及其潜在影响和解决方案

不同观点：
• **genedan** 推荐了一部名为《Planetes》的动漫，通过娱乐内容引起人们对太空垃圾问题的关注。
• **fredzel** 表达了对Kessler综合症的担忧，认为它可能阻碍人类进行太空探索，且普通人无法应对这一问题。
• **matthewdgreen** 提出了关于SpaceX的Starship项目经济可行性和其对Kessler综合症风险影响的疑问。他担心Starship的大规模发射会增加太空垃圾风险，并询问是否有人对此进行过建模分析。
• **asix66** 提到了Steve Wozniak的Privateer公司，其最初目标是清理太空垃圾，但现在转向通过更好的跟踪技术来预防碰撞事故，并提供了一个互动式太空物体追踪链接。
• **Towaway69** 以讽刺口吻指出，人类面临气候危机、贸易危机和太空危机等多重危机，似乎进入了“危机危机”时代。
• **sebg** 分享了一个名为“What’s in Space”的网站链接，提供实时的地球轨道物体3D地图可视化。
• **aziaziazi** 纠正了sebg的链接，提供了正确的视频链接。
• **dang** 确认了aziaziazi提供的视频链接，并澄清了链接内容。
• **aeinbu** 以幽默方式提问，如果人类被Kessler综合症“锁住”，那么外星生命是否也无法“访问”地球。
• **pandemic_region** 提出了类似于“海洋清理”项目的太空垃圾清理方案，认为如果能够有效发现太空垃圾，或许可以开发一种设备将其推向外太空。
• **cies** 提到了StarLink卫星在失效后会重新进入大气层，并对地球生命造成影响，批评这是一种将成本外部化而利润内部化的行为，并提供了一篇相关文章的链接。

补充讨论：
• Kessler综合症作为太空垃圾问题的核心，引发了关于其对未来太空探索和商业发射项目影响的讨论。
• SpaceX的Starship项目被视为可能增加太空垃圾风险的一个因素，但具体影响尚不明确，需要进一步的建模和分析。
• 提出了Privateer公司和“What’s in Space”网站等技术解决方案，通过跟踪和可视化技术来预防太空碰撞事故。
• 有讨论者以幽默或讽刺的方式表达了对多重危机的无奈和对太空垃圾问题的关注。
• 有人提出了类似于海洋清理项目的太空垃圾清理方案，但其实际可行性尚待验证。

data.title: InitWare, a portable systemd fork running on BSDs and Linux
data.author: sunshine-o
data.article_summary: InitWare是一套中间件套件，用于将服务和系统资源作为逻辑实体（称为单元）进行管理。其主要组件是一个服务管理系统，能够在NetBSD、GNU/Linux及其他现代BSD系统上运行。InitWare通过作业调度器根据依赖关系自动调度单元，并提供用户会话管理器和系统日志。它可以作为init系统或辅助服务管理系统运行，源于systemd的分支，并在许多接口上保持与systemd的兼容性。当前为alpha版本，建议在生产环境中谨慎使用，直到发布首个稳定版本。InitWare根据LGPL-2.1许可证发布，支持多种平台，并提供了详细的构建和贡献指南。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：围绕InitWare项目及其与systemd的比较，讨论不同init系统的优缺点，以及在桌面环境和容器操作系统中的适用性。

不同观点：
• 支持InitWare的观点：
   - InitWare项目提供了模块化和可选的服务管理，不像systemd那样强制整合过多功能（LinuxBender）。
   - InitWare的Dropped Components部分令人鼓舞，可能成为Debian系统上替代systemd的选择，避免systemd的过度干预（foresto）。
   - InitWare的轻量化和可选性使其更适合那些不喜欢systemd掌控一切的用户（travisgriggs）。

• 批评systemd的观点：
   - systemd变得过于庞大，试图掌控系统的一切，而InitWare更接近理想中的服务控制管理器（donnachangstein）。
   - systemd的复杂性和频繁更新会导致用户花费大量时间解决兼容性问题，而InitWare提供了一种更简洁的选择（exceptione）。

• 中立/比较观点：
   - 提到macOS的launchd，认为如果能在Linux上适用，可能会成为统一的init系统（dontlaugh）。
   - 比较InitWare与dinit（matu3ba），指出两者在目标上的相似性。
   - 提到其他替代方案如supervisord，认为其在Alpine上表现良好（udev4096）。

补充讨论：
• 项目活跃度问题：
   - 指出InitWare项目在过去几年中提交不活跃，可能需要更多贡献或资金支持（WD-42, LinuxBender）。

• 安全性和公司支持：
   - 认为默认拒绝所有访问并明确选择进程需要的权限是更好的安全策略，而systemd的默认允许所有访问不够安全（egberts1）。
   - 提到systemd的优势在于有公司支持，使得捐赠和项目维护更加可行（Vilian）。

• 幽默和讽刺：
   - 有些评论以幽默和讽刺的方式表达了对新项目出现的态度（betimsl, johnea）。

争议焦点：
• systemd的复杂性和功能扩展是否合理及其对系统管理的影响。
• InitWare及其他替代init系统的可行性和活跃度。

Please note that InitWare is still alpha software
. But all disclosed
security concerns have now been addressed. Running InitWare as an auxiliary
service manager under NetBSD can now, then, be regarded as safe; but beware
relying on this in production until a first stable release is made.
The InitWare Suite of Middleware allows you to manage services and system
resources as logical entities called units. It runs on NetBSD, GNU/Linux, and
all the other modern BSD systems.
Units are automatically scheduled by a job scheduler according to their
dependency specifications. A user session manager facilitates tracking of users'
login sessions, with each user provided their own dedicated service manager.
Finally the InitWare System Log provides a system-wide event log aggregating
diverse log sources.
The Suite may run either as an init system or as an auxiliary service management
system under another init system. InitWare originates as a fork of systemd and
retains compatibility with many systemd interfaces, even on non-Linux platforms.
Platform
Build Status
GNU/Linux (Alpine)
FreeBSD
NetBSD
OpenBSD
Frequently Asked Questions
How does InitWare differ from systemd?
In three ways: InitWare is highly portable, it is more modular, and it is of a
much more clearly-defined scope. See
The InitWare philosophy
.
Some components of systemd failing to provide compelling benefits are dropped;
see
Dropped components
.
How compatible is InitWare with systemd?
Unit-files, the
systemctl
,
loginctl
, and
journalctl
commands (provided as
svcctl
,
sessionctl
, and
syslogctl
respectively), the systemd1 and Login1
D-Bus APIs, the sd_notify API, the journald stream and datagram socket
protocols, and several other interfaces are largely supported on all ports.
Some details differ by port. See
Systemd compatibility
.
On what platforms does InitWare run?
InitWare is native to NetBSD. It runs on NetBSD, FreeBSD, and GNU/Linux - its
first-class targets - as an init system; on macOS, DragonFly BSD and OpenBSD, it
runs as an auxiliary service manager. See
Support matrix
.
Under what licence is InitWare released?
Most code is under the GNU Library GPL v2.1, some of it is under liberal licences.
How does one build InitWare?
Install the dependencies first: these are a C toolchain, cmake, gperf, m4, awk,
pkg-config or pkgconf, and on BSD platforms, libinotify. Then run:
git submodule update --init --recursive && cmake && make && make install
See
Building
for further details.
Where will InitWare go from here?
Check the Issues and Projects tabs, or the
Roadmap
.
How can I contribute?
See
Contributing
.
Where can I find out more?
Check
the Wiki
. The
Myths and Truths
page is a good place to start.

data.title: Show HN: Offline JavaScript PubSub between browser tabs
data.author: l1am0
data.article_summary: TabSub 是一个通过浏览器本地存储实现的跨标签页发布-订阅（PubSub）机制的 JavaScript 工具。它无需服务器，所有消息通过 localStorage 共享，仅在同域下有效。作者测试了 10 个并发写入，未出现消息丢失或顺序错误，但不能保证大规模并发安全，使用需自担风险。TabSub 提供了 `publish`、`subscribe` 和 `state` 等函数来发布消息、注册监听和获取主题当前状态。示例展示了如何同步多个标签页中的音频播放。TabSub 已在 GitHub 开源，采用 MIT 许可。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：对 `subscribe()` 实现的优化、跨浏览器通信方案、安全性问题以及不同技术选择的比较和应用

不同观点：
• **对 `subscribe()` 实现效率的看法**：

Offline Javascript PubSub between browser tabs
TabSub offers you an easy to use Javascript PubSub via local storage. No server is required as all messages are shared via the browser built in local storage.

• 另一方则关注加密货币系统的脆弱性和安全性问题。abidhusain强调，国家背景的黑客对加密货币世界的攻击日益频繁，显示出该系统仍然非常脆弱。IncreasePosts则指出，北韩的经济很大程度上依赖于加密货币盗窃，这一现象令人担忧。

• 还有观点聚焦于对加密货币的整体批评和不信任。josefritzishere认为，加密货币缺乏如传统银行系统的FDIC保障，被盗资金难以追回，显示出其作为货币的缺陷。

data.article_summary: nix-ninja 是一个与 Ninja 兼容的增量构建系统，利用 Nix 动态衍生功能来处理 Ninja 构建文件，支持如 CMake、Meson 等输出 Ninja 的构建系统。其主要特性包括解析 ninja.build 文件、将构建输入和输出存储为内容寻址的衍生，以及兼容 Ninja 的命令行工具。使用时需依赖 Nix 的实验性功能，如 "dynamic-derivations"。用户可以通过克隆项目并启用相关实验功能来构建示例项目。目前该项目仍在开发中，欢迎贡献代码，特别是解决主要的待办事项和性能改进。该项目代码基于 MIT 许可协议。

nix-ninja
Incremental compilation of
Ninja build files
using
Nix Dynamic Derivations
.
Choosing ninja as the build graph representation lets us support any build
system that outputs ninja like CMake, meson, premake, gn, etc.
Key features
•
Getting started

Design notes

Contributing
Key features
Important
There are still major todos, and depends on experimental features from an
unreleased version of Nix. Come help us get nix-ninja to be useful day-to-day
and working with an official Nix release!
Parses
ninja.build
files and generates a derivation per compilation unit.
Stores build inputs & outputs in content-addressed derivations for granular
and Nix-native incrementality.
Compatible CLI for ninja, so if you set
$NINJA
to
nix-ninja
then meson
just works.
Supports running locally (which runs
nix build
on your behalf), or inside a
Nix derivation (which creates dynamic derivations).
Getting started
First you need to use
nix@d904921
and enable the following experimental
features:
experimental-features = [
"
nix-command
"
"
dynamic-derivations
"
"
ca-derivations
"
"
recursive-nix
"
]
Then you can try building the examples:
#
Builds a basic main.cpp.
nix build github:pdtpartners/nix-ninja#example-hello
#
Builds a basic main.cpp with dependency inference for its header.
nix build github:pdtpartners/nix-ninja#example-header
#
Builds Nix 2.27.1.
nix build github:pdtpartners/nix-ninja#example-nix
You can also try running
nix-ninja
outside of Nix, but you'll need both
nix-ninja
and
nix-ninja-task
to be in your
$PATH
. Make sure
nix-ninja-task
is from the
/nix/store
as it is needed inside derivations
nix-ninja
generates.
export
NIX_NINJA=
$(
nix build --print-out-paths
)
export
PATH=
"
${NIX_NINJA}
/bin:
$PATH
"
#
Meson respects this environment variable and uses it as if its ninja.
export
NINJA=
"
${NIX_NINJA}
/bin/nix-ninja
"
Then you can go to an example and run it like so:
$ nix-shell
$
cd
examples/hello
$ meson setup build
$
cd
build
$ meson compile hello
$ ./hello
Hello Nix dynamic derivations
!
Contributing
We still have major TODOs, so would appreciate any help. We've organize them
under two
GitHub milestones
:
0.1.0
- The first release of
nix-ninja
aiming for correctness.
0.2.0
- Major performance features to make incremental builds productive.
Regardless, pull requests are welcome for any changes. Consider opening an issue
to discuss larger changes first, especially when the design space is large.
Please read
CONTRIBUTING
and the
design notes
so you
understand the big picture and prior art.

data.title: Reasoning models don't always say what they think
data.author: meetpateltech
data.article_summary: 无法获取文章内容
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：大型语言模型（LLM）的思维链（Chain of Thought, CoT）是否能够真正反映模型的内部推理过程，以及CoT的实际作用和局限。

不同观点：
• lsy：认为CoT并不能真正解释LLM的内部过程，输出只是为了优化RLHF（人类反馈的强化学习）和贴近训练数据，CoT只是增加了上下文，提高了在统计上得到正确答案的可能性，而非真正的解释。
• pton_xd：支持lsy的观点，认为CoT只是增加了上下文和计算量，而不是展示LLM的推理过程。
• xg15：认为CoT中的推理过程本质上就是 token 的生成过程，尽管模型隐藏层的状态在预测下一个 token 时存在，但这些信息在预测完成后就会消失。
• PeterStuer：认为人类也有事后合理化的现象，LLM 提供合理的论证即使不是实际的生成过程也无妨，要求解释与生产过程完全一致可能会导致难以理解的解释或受限的生产系统。
• ctoth：讽刺地认为那些认为人类不仅仅是“复杂的自动补全”的人也应该看看这个讨论。
• lpzimm：通过实验发现，带有暗示的问题会影响LLM的答案，显示出CoT可能受到提示的显著影响。
• zurfer：分享了一个例子，显示Sonnet 3.7在思考过程中选择了某个选项，但在最终输出中却选择了另一个选项，没有给出明确的理由。
• thoughtlede：认为研究假设有“循环论证”的嫌疑，因为推理模型训练的目标是输出增加正确答案概率的token，而不是忠实地包含提示。
• richardw：指出推理模型变得更自信，但可能导致坚持错误的想法，使得用户难以控制输出结果。
• alach11：认为这是对OpenAI的批评，指出Anthropic的研究表明使用思维痕迹进行对齐的方法不可靠。
• madethisnow：提出如果某物让你相信它有意识，那么它就有意识，模拟计算就是计算本身。
• evrimoztamur：认为LLM可能在未测试其上下文假设的情况下短路，经常根据用户的隐含预期答案进行解释。
• afro88：质疑模型是否能够知道它使用了某个提示，还是只是在被问及时根据训练内容进行回答。
• islewis：认为文章中提到的“令人担忧”的结论可能有些夸大，因为实验只是证明了模型在奖励机制下会表现出不良行为。

补充讨论：
• 关于CoT是否真正反映LLM的推理过程存在争议，一部分人认为只是增加了上下文和计算量，另一部分人则认为这是合理的解释过程。
• 模型自信与错误坚持的问题被多次提到，显示出用户在控制和引导模型输出方面的困难。
• 对OpenAI和Anthropic在LLM对齐和思维痕迹使用上的不同方法进行了对比和批评。
• 实验表明提示对LLM输出有显著影响，显示出CoT在实际应用中的局限性和潜在偏差。

data.title: Curl-impersonate: Special build of curl that can impersonate the major browsers
data.author: mmh0000
data.article_summary:
`curl-impersonate` 是一个修改版的 curl，能够模拟 Chrome、Firefox、Edge 和 Safari 四大浏览器。它通过调整 TLS 和 HTTP 握手过程，使其与真实浏览器的表现完全一致，从而绕过网站对客户端进行的 TLS 和 HTTP/2 指纹识别。该工具可以像常规 curl 一样从命令行使用，也可以作为库集成到项目中替代常规的 libcurl。

为了实现模拟，`curl-impersonate` 做了以下修改：
1. 使用与浏览器相同的 TLS 库（如 Firefox 的 NSS 和 Chrome 的 BoringSSL）。
2. 调整 TLS 扩展和 SSL 选项。
3. 修改 HTTP/2 连接设置。
4. 使用特定标志运行，如 `--ciphers` 和 `--curves`。

该工具支持多个版本的浏览器，并提供了包装脚本方便使用。详细使用方法和支持的浏览器列表可以在文档中找到。

curl-impersonate
A special build of
curl
that can impersonate the four major browsers: Chrome, Edge, Safari & Firefox. curl-impersonate is able to perform TLS and HTTP handshakes that are identical to that of a real browser.
curl-impersonate can be used either as a command line tool, similar to the regular curl, or as a library that can be integrated instead of the regular libcurl. See
Usage
below.
Why?
When you use an HTTP client with a TLS website, it first performs a TLS handshake. The first message of that handshake is called Client Hello. The Client Hello message that most HTTP clients and libraries produce differs drastically from that of a real browser.
If the server uses HTTP/2, then in addition to the TLS handshake there is also an HTTP/2 handshake where various settings are exchanged. The settings that most HTTP clients and libraries use differ as well from those of any real browsers.
For these reasons, some web services use the TLS and HTTP handshakes to fingerprint which client is accessing them, and then present different content for different clients. These methods are known as
TLS fingerprinting
and
HTTP/2 fingerprinting
respectively. Their widespread use has led to the web becoming less open, less private and much more restrictive towards specific web clients
With the modified curl in this repository, the TLS and HTTP handshakes look
exactly
like those of a real browser.
How?
To make this work,
curl
was patched significantly to resemble a browser. Specifically, The modifications that were needed to make this work:
Compiling curl with nss, the TLS library that Firefox uses, instead of OpenSSL. For the Chrome version, compiling with BoringSSL, Google's TLS library.
Modifying the way curl configures various TLS extensions and SSL options.
Adding support for new TLS extensions.
Changing the settings that curl uses for its HTTP/2 connections.
Running curl with some non-default flags, for example
--ciphers
,
--curves
and some
-H
headers.
The resulting curl looks, from a network perspective, identical to a real browser.
Read the full technical description in the blog posts:
part a
,
part b
.

Basic usage
For each supported browser there is a wrapper script that launches
curl-impersonate
with all the needed headers and flags. For example:
curl_chrome116 https://www.wikipedia.org
You can add command line flags and they will be passed on to curl. However, some flags change curl's TLS signature which may cause it to be detected.
Please note that the wrapper scripts use a default set of HTTP headers. If you want to change these headers, you may want to modify the wrapper scripts to fit your own purpose.

data.title: Show HN: The C3 programming language (C alternative language)
data.author: lerno
data.article_summary: C3是一种基于C语言语法和语义的编程语言，旨在进化C语言的同时保持C程序员熟悉的特性。C3强调与C语言的ABI兼容性，可以轻松在同一项目中混合使用C和C3代码。其设计原则包括保持C语言的核心特性，仅在必要时进行修改，并引入一些高层次的便利功能。C3没有强制性的头文件，采用基于模块的命名空间，支持切片、编译时反射、增强的编译时执行、基于泛型模块的泛型编程、基于"Result"类型的零开销错误处理、延迟执行（defer）、值方法、关联枚举数据等特性。C3的灵感来源于C2语言，旨在迭代C语言而不是创造一种全新的语言。预编译的二进制文件适用于Windows x64、Debian x64、Ubuntu x86和MacOS Arm64等操作系统。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：对C3编程语言的评价与讨论，包括语法、功能、与类似语言的对比以及对特定语言特性的需求和建议。

不同观点：
• [sfpotter] 认为使用 `::` 语法很丑陋，支持像D语言那样统一使用 `.`。他强调了简洁语法的重要性。
• [micklemeal] 实际使用后觉得C3在整合C库方面表现最好，尤其是与raylib和libtmx的整合，并对C3未来获得更多认可抱有期待。
• [dooglius] 提出C3与Zig、Odin的对比，这些语言都有改进C的相同目标，并质疑C3能否获得同样的关注。
• [Sohcahtoa82] 喜欢C3在switch/case行为上的改变，但对使用 `fn` 定义函数的必要性提出疑问，并表示如果需要用C语言时会考虑C3。

补充讨论：
• [dkersten] 对C3的整体印象积极，但对某些语法选择（如函数定义格式）有不同偏好，理解其设计背后的原因。
• [johnisgood] 关心标准库的贡献（如添加BLAKE2）以及如何使用不同的哈希算法实现“rehash”，并对线程安全的哈希表是否能进入标准库表示关注。
• [moktonar] 对使用 `fn` 标记函数定义的必要性提出疑问。
• [unclad5968] 使用C3后觉得不错，但希望有标记联合类型，并提到该特性已在计划中。
• [CyberDildonics] 认为系统语言应具备泛型、析构函数和所有权三个特性，而C3只具备泛型，对此表示遗憾。

• [owlstuffing] 认为C3在处理宏和条件编译方面不够理想，质疑其设计选择。

• [alcover] 询问如何表达只读指针，类似于C语言中的 `const int* ptr`。

争议焦点：
• 语法选择，尤其是 `::` 和 `fn` 的使用，部分开发者认为这些增加了不必要的复杂性。
• 与Zig、Odin等类似语言的对比，讨论C3能否脱颖而出。
• 对C3应具备哪些核心系统语言特性的不同看法，如是否需要所有权和析构函数。

这些讨论反映了开发者对C3的不同期望和需求，尤其是关于语言设计和功能实现的争议。

C3 Language
C3 is a programming language that builds on the syntax and semantics of the C language,
with the goal of evolving it while still retaining familiarity for C programmers.
It's an evolution, not a revolution: the C-like
for programmers who like C.
Precompiled binaries for the following operating systems are available:
Windows x64
download
,
install instructions
.
Debian x64
download
,
install instructions
.
Ubuntu x86
download
,
install instructions
.
MacOS Arm64
download
,
install instructions
.
The manual for C3 can be found at
www.c3-lang.org
.
Thanks to full ABI compatibility with C, it's possible to mix C and C3 in the same project with no effort. As a demonstration, vkQuake was compiled with a small portion of the code converted to C3 and compiled with the c3c compiler. (The fork can be found at
https://github.com/c3lang/vkQuake
)
Design Principles
Procedural "get things done"-type of language.
Try to stay close to C - only change what's really necessary.
C ABI compatibility and excellent C integration.
Learning C3 should be easy for a C programmer.
Data is inert.
Avoid "big ideas" & the "more is better" fallacy.
Introduce some higher level conveniences where the value is great.
C3 owes its inspiration to the
C2 language
: to iterate on top of C without trying to be a
whole new language.

The following code shows
generic modules
(more examples can be found at
https://c3-lang.org/references/docs/examples/
).

//

{
usz capacity;

}

//

//

void
Stack.push(Stack*
this
, Type element)
{
if
(
this
.
capacity
==
this
.
size
)
{
this
.
capacity
*=
2
;
if
(
this
.
capacity
<
16
)
this
.
capacity
=
16
;
this
.
elems
=
realloc
(
this
.
elems
, Type.
sizeof
*
this
.
capacity
);
}
this
.
elems
[
this
.
size
++] = element;
}
fn Type Stack.pop(Stack*
this
)
{
assert
(
this
.
size
>
0
);
return
this
.
elems
[--
this
.
size
];
}
fn
bool
Stack.empty(Stack*
this
)
{
return
!
this
.
size
;
}

a complete copy of the entire Stack module with "Type" set to "int"

Importing an external C function is straightforward

here is an example of importing libc's printf:

fn

(
char

void
main
()

IntStack stack;

//
so the above is equivalent to IntStack stack = {};

1

No mandatory header files
New semantic macro system
Module based name spacing
Slices
Compile time reflection
Enhanced compile time execution
Generics based on generic modules
"Result"-based zero overhead error handling
Defer
Value methods
Associated enum data
No preprocessor

data.author: lmazgon
data.article_summary: Benchi 是一个简化的基准测试框架，利用 Docker 创建隔离环境进行基准测试和收集指标。其主要功能包括 Docker 集成、指标收集、自定义钩子以及进度监控。用户可以通过配置文件定义基础设施和工具，使用 Docker Compose 管理环境，并实时监控容器状态和指标。结果以 CSV 格式存储，包含修剪平均值处理后的聚合指标，以及每个基准测试运行的详细日志和原始指标。Benchi 还支持通过命令行参数自定义输出目录和过滤测试工具。Docker 网络和环境变量的使用确保了测试环境的可配置性和互通性。安装和使用可通过 Go 命令或提供的脚本完成。

Benchi
Benchi is a minimal benchmarking framework designed to help you measure the
performance of your applications and infrastructure. It leverages Docker to
create isolated environments for running benchmarks and collecting metrics.
It was developed to simplify the process of setting up and running benchmarks
for
Conduit
.
Features
Docker Integration
: Define and manage your benchmarking environments using
Docker Compose.
Metrics Collection
: Collect and export metrics in CSV format for further
analysis.
Custom Hooks
: Define custom hooks to run commands at various stages of the
benchmark.
Progress Monitoring
: Real-time monitoring of container statuses and
metrics during the benchmark run.
Installation
To install Benchi, download
the
latest release
or
install it using Go:
go install github.com/conduitio/benchi/cmd/benchi@latest
Alternatively, you can install just the Benchi binary on a Linux OS with:
curl https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ConduitIO/benchi/main/install.sh
|
sh
Usage
Running Benchmarks
Run benchi and point
-config
to a benchmark
configuration file
.
The repository includes an
example benchmark
, which can be run
using the following command:
benchi -config ./example/bench-kafka-kafka/bench.yml
Results
Running the benchmark will store the results in a folder named after the current
date and time inside of
results
(e.g.
results/20060102_150405
). You can
adjust the output folder using the
-out
flag.
The output folder will contain two files:
benchi.log
: Log file containing the full output of benchi.
aggregated-results.csv
: Aggregated metric results from all collectors and
all tests. The results are aggregated using a
trimmed mean
, where the top
and bottom 5% of the results are removed. Benchi also disregards any 0 values
from the start and end of the test, to accomodate for warm-up and cool-down
periods.
The output folder will also contain one folder per benchmark run (i.e. per test
and tool combination). Each benchmark run folder will contain:
infra_NAME.log
: Log file containing the output of the infrastructure docker
containers, split per infra service.
tool_NAME.log
: Log file containing the output of the tool docker containers.
COLLECTOR.csv
: Raw metrics collected using the corresponding
metrics collector
.
Command-Line Flags
-config
: Path to the benchmark config file (required).
-out
: Path to the output folder (default:
./results/${now}
*).
-tool
: Filter tool to be tested (can be provided multiple times).
-tests
: Filter test to run (can be provided multiple times).
*
${now}
is replaced with the current time formatted as
YYYYMMDD_HHMMSS
.
Docker network
Benchi creates a Docker network named
benchi
to connect the infrastructure
services and tools. This network is created automatically and removed after the
benchmark run. Please make sure to connect your services to this network to
ensure they can communicate with each other.
Example Docker Compose configuration:
services
:
my-service
:
networks
:
-
benchi
networks
:
benchi
:
external
:
true
Environment variables
Benchi runs all Docker Compose commands using the same environment variables as
the current shell. This means that you can use environment variables to pass
values to your services.
For instance, having the following Docker Compose configuration:
services
:
my-service
:
environment
:
-
MY_ENV_VAR=${MY_ENV_VAR}
You can inject the environment variable by running Benchi as follows:
MY_ENV_VAR=my-value benchi -config ./my-benchmark.yml
Configuration
Benchi uses a YAML configuration file to define the benchmark in combination
with Docker Compose configurations.
Below is an example configuration:

database

compose
:
"
./compose-database.yml
"

"

./compose-my-app.yml
"

http://localhost:9090/metrics

data.article_summary: Anime.js 是一个快速、多功能的 JavaScript 动画库，能够突破浏览器限制，通过单一API实现网页上的各种动画效果。它具有直观的API，支持逐属性参数设置、灵活的关键帧系统、内置缓动效果和增强的CSS变换。此外，它还支持SVG图形变形、线条绘制和路径跟随，并可以通过Scroll Observer API实现滚动同步动画。Anime.js 提供高级交错效果和拖拽功能，并支持响应式动画和模块化导入，以保持较小的包体积。该库还包括详细的文档和示例代码，帮助开发者快速上手。Anime.js 是免费的，并依赖赞助商的支持。

data.author: b0bben

data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：用户对一款具有赛博朋克风格的语音/文本聊天应用的反馈与建议

不同观点：
• [b0bben] 认为当前的程序无聊，想打造一个具有赛博朋克风格的社区平台。他描述了自己正在开发的项目，尽管还在早期阶段，但他对开发过程感到非常兴奋，并希望吸引更多人从Discord转移到他的平台。他也表达了希望将该项目发展成一个真正的产品并以此为生的愿望。

• [panja] 对隐私问题表示关注，特别是用户数据的管理方式，询问是否有端到端加密（e2ee）的计划。

• [Layogtima] 对项目表示喜爱，询问是否会开源，并表示有兴趣将其用于模拟Vogon Constructor Fleet船舰的界面。

• [jagermo] 建议添加骰子滚动功能和别名功能，以便于进行Shadowrun或Cyberpunk等桌面角色扮演游戏。

• [egypturnash] 对视频示例中缺少实际图片表示失望，但个人风格上认可该项目的赛博朋克风格。

• [jamauro] 和 [indigoabstract] 都对项目表示赞赏和鼓励，认为其风格酷似黑客游戏的用户界面。

• [cyberpunk] 以幽默的方式表达了对项目风格的认可，但也指出项目缺少一些与他个人品牌相关的标志性元素，如九寸钉乐队T恤、破洞牛仔裤、对字体和耳机的独特品味等。

补充讨论：
• b0bben提供了一个早期alpha版本的下载链接，并提醒用户注意安全，因为Windows版本尚未签署证书。
• 用户对隐私、开源、功能扩展（如骰子滚动和别名功能）以及风格细节等方面提出了具体建议和期望。

争议焦点：
• 目前没有明显的争议，但[panja]提出的隐私问题可能成为未来讨论的焦点，特别是在用户数据管理方面。

data.title: Windows debloat script made by Microsoft
data.author: homebrewer
data.article_summary: 这篇文章介绍了一个PowerShell脚本（RemoveDefaultApps.ps1），用于卸载Windows系统中预装的某些默认应用程序。这些应用包括如Microsoft.BingFinance、Microsoft.BingNews、Microsoft.Solitaire等。脚本通过调用`Get-AppxPackage`和`Remove-AppxPackage`等PowerShell命令来移除用户和系统中的指定应用，并参考了多个微软文档和社区资源。此脚本旨在帮助用户清理不必要的预装软件，以优化系统性能和减少干扰。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：微软操作系统去肿胀脚本的可信度及其实际效果

不同观点：
• [zadkey] 对微软提供的去肿胀脚本持怀疑态度，认为即使脚本减少了一些内容，可能仍会故意留下一些残余部分，尤其对微软自家操作系统的不信任。
• [LinuxBender] 提到另一个去肿胀脚本，该脚本由多人贡献，可以移除遥测功能及其他内容，同时提醒使用此类脚本前应备份注册表和系统，提供了一个GitHub链接供参考。
• [Group_B] 以幽默的方式猜测是否有微软开发人员使用去肿胀脚本清理自己的开发环境，并暗示去肿胀操作可能影响开发中的应用程序。
• [tarnith] 推荐了一个更为彻底的去肿胀脚本，提供了一个不同的GitHub链接，认为该脚本比之前提到的更全面。
• [trinix912] 指出文中提到的脚本仅移除APPX包，而未处理其他肿胀部分（如系统级别的遥测功能），质疑其彻底性。

补充讨论：
• 不同用户对去肿胀脚本的推荐，显示出社区中存在多种选择，且这些脚本的功能和效果存在差异。
• 争议的焦点在于微软自家去肿胀脚本的可信度和彻底性，部分用户认为微软可能会故意保留一些内容，而其他第三方脚本则可能更全面。
• 使用去肿胀脚本的风险被提及，如对注册表和系统的备份需求，显示出用户对系统稳定性的关注。
• 讨论还涉及到对不同脚本具体功能的对比，尤其是对遥测功能和系统级内容的处理效果。

data.author: atum47
data.article_summary: 这篇文章介绍了victorqribeiro开发的Chip8js项目，一个用JavaScript编写的Chip-8模拟器。该项目包含20个星标和0个分支。Chip8js支持通过键盘控制，按键包括1, 2, 3, 4, q, w, e, r, a, s, d, f, z, x, c, v。项目文件包括JavaScript代码、ROM文件、README说明、演示和游戏数据等。主要技术栈为JavaScript（94.6%）和HTML（5.4%）。项目页面提供了在线演示链接。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：关于编写CHIP-8模拟器的讨论及相关技术选择的交流

不同观点：
• [atum47] 认为CHIP-8是初次尝试编写模拟器的一个较好选择，并提到使用了tiny.js来处理显示部分，试图模拟 old monitor 的发光效果。这表明他关注模拟器的易实现性和视觉效果的仿真。

• [postalrat] 提出了一个不同的技术挑战，提供了一个链接，建议如果还想再次尝试编写模拟器，可以考虑一个只有单条指令的语言（BytePusher），这暗示了对极简指令集或更具挑战性的编程实验的兴趣。

• [asciimov] 对帖子的重复性提出了质疑，询问是否前几天已经发布过相同的内容，表明他对讨论内容的新鲜度和是否有重复发帖有所关注。

• [bitwize] 对CHIP-8有高度评价，称其为“世界上第一个幻想游戏机”（world's first fantasy console），显示出对CHIP-8历史地位的认可，并可能暗示其在复古计算和模拟器社区中的经典地位。

• [ghffcvb] 简单地对作品表示赞赏，没有深入讨论技术细节，只是表达了对atum47工作的肯定。

补充讨论：
• 争议焦点：[asciimov] 对帖子重复性的质疑可能引发对论坛发帖规范或内容重复的讨论，但目前尚未展开深入争论。
• 技术选择：[atum47] 和 [postalrat] 提出了两种不同的技术路径，前者选择了相对简单的CHIP-8，后者推荐了更具挑战性的BytePusher，这为其他读者提供了不同的技术选择和思考方向。

data.title: Thoughts on ISAs (income sharing agreements)
data.author: endlessvoid94
data.article_summary: 无法获取文章内容
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：编程训练营（bootcamps）的现状及其与就业市场的关系，特别是与大学毕业生的竞争。

不同观点：
• [对ISAs（收入分享协议）的看法分歧]  
  ◦ 一部分人曾经对Lambda School采用ISAs表示赞扬，认为这是一种帮助学生在没有前期成本的情况下完成学业的好方法。  
  ◦ 然而，随着Lambda School被曝出存在一些掠夺性行为，公众对ISAs的看法变得负面。

• [编程训练营的就业市场状况]  
  ◦ 有人质疑编程训练营是否仍然表现良好，尤其在当前就业市场似乎无法为传统大学毕业生提供足够的岗位。这暗示训练营毕业生的就业前景可能更加严峻。

补充讨论：
• [ISAs的潜在问题]  
  ◦ ISAs虽然初期被认为是减轻学生经济负担的创新方式，但由于某些机构的掠夺性行为，这种模式的实际效果和道德性受到质疑。

• [就业市场竞争]  
  ◦ 讨论中提到大学毕业生和编程训练营毕业生之间的就业竞争，反映了科技行业就业市场可能供过于求的担忧。这表明不仅训练营的学生，即使是大学毕业生也在面临就业挑战。

争议焦点：ISAs是否是帮助学生负担教育的好方法，以及编程训练营毕业生在当前就业市场中的竞争力。

data.title: Electron band structure in germanium, my ass (2001)
data.author: tux3
data.article_summary: 无法获取文章内容
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：科学实验中的精确性、科学教育中的评分标准、科研工作中的现实问题以及科学历史的背景。

不同观点：
• [jerf的观点] 科学实验中的精确性难以保证，尤其是在使用不精确的工具（如老式手表）时。jerf指出，在高中物理实验中使用这种工具测量重力加速度，结果非常不准确，且这种不准确在科学教育中往往得不到宽容。他进一步批评科学教育和科研中对“正确”结果的追求，认为科学家经常在数据不理想的情况下“捏造”结果。

• [roadbuster的观点] 支持jerf的经历，认为其揭示了大学本科生活中的现实，并提到jerf后来转向了计算机科学领域，最终取得了博士学位，这表明在面对科学实验和教育中的挫折时，职业生涯的转向可能是解决办法。

• [sevensor的观点] 分享了在教授半导体制造实验课时的类似经历，强调了实验安全的重要性，同时也对学生在实验中遇到的困难和实验结果的不准确表示理解，认为这种情况很常见。

• [cosmic_quanta的观点] 提到在其研究的超快凝聚态物理领域中，存在通过曲线拟合来合理化不准确数据的现象，且往往不呈现残差或其他拟合优度测试，暗示这种做法在科研中可能广泛存在。

• [HiPHInch的观点] 提到在量子化学计算研究中遇到的困难，特别是许多研究工作是闭源的，难以复现。此外，使用非自由许可的软件（如Origin和MS Word）也增加了协作和复现的难度。

• [aylmao的观点] 提供了jerf的教育和职业背景信息，强调他最终在计算机科学领域取得了成功，并在知名公司工作，这与他在物理实验中的挫折形成对比。

• [janandonly的观点] 认为jerf的帖子揭示了物理科学中的现实问题，并对其进行了讽刺，表明对物理科学的选择和其带来的挫折感。

• [joquarky的观点] 提供了对jerf实验失败的总结，并提到其对物理学研究的失望，最终选择了计算机科学，这与原文内容一致。

• [jpmattia的观点] 强调了固体物理学中的能带结构理论的美丽和重要性，认为其对社会的改变是显著的，暗示对科学研究应有更深的理解和欣赏。

• [shadowgovt的观点] 通过讲述华氏温标的历史背景，说明了早期科学测量中的实际问题和解决方案，提供了对科学实验中工具和方法的历史视角。

• [smaddox的观点] 提供了关于如何正确测量半导体材料电阻率的技术细节，强调了使用专业设备（如四探针法）的重要性，指出了在科学实验中使用正确方法和工具的必要性。

• [jpm_sd的观点] 认为本科实验中的挫折如果能放在历史背景中理解，可能会更容易接受，并建议在教学中更好地解释历史上的科学发现过程，以帮助学生理解和应对实验中的困难。

补充讨论：
• 科研中的现实问题：多个评论提到了科研工作中数据不准确、实验困难和工具不精确的问题，以及如何在面对这些问题时继续推进科学研究。
• 科学教育的评分标准：jerf批评了科学教育中对“正确”结果的追求，认为学生应根据实际情况和努力程度得到评价，而不是仅仅根据结果。
• 科学历史的背景：一些评论提到了科学实验和测量中的历史背景，提供了对现代科学实验中遇到的问题的更深刻理解。
• 职业生涯的转向：jerf最终转向了计算机科学，并在该领域取得了成功，这表明在面对科学实验和教育中的挫折时，职业生涯的转向可能是解决办法。

data.title: Parrots and humans share a brain mechanism for speech
data.author: gmays
data.article_summary: 一项发表于2025年3月19日《Nature》的研究显示，小型鹦鹉（虎皮鹦鹉，*Melopsittacus undulatus*）的大脑具有类似于人类语言产生的机制。纽约大学Langone Health的神经科学家Michael Long及其同事发现，虎皮鹦鹉大脑中的前弓状体区域存在与发声相关的神经细胞，其组织方式类似于“声音键盘”，可以产生各种声音，类似于人类语言的灵活性。这种相似性可能是趋同进化的结果，即人类和鹦鹉分别演化出相似的语言机制。研究人员正试图利用机器学习解析鹦鹉的“语言”，以进一步理解其交流内容及其与人类语言的相似性。这项研究可能挑战“人类独特性”的观念。

By
Laura Sanders
March 19, 2025 at 12:00 pm
Updated
March 20, 2025 at 9:58 am
When it comes to speech, parrots have the gift of gab. And the way the brains of small parrots known as budgerigars bestow this gift is
remarkably similar to human speech
, researchers report March 19 in
Nature
.
So far, budgerigars are the only animals known to have language-producing centers akin to those in humans, says Michael Long, a neuroscientist at New York University Langone Health. This “is really the first nonhuman animal in which that has been shown.” Understanding how speech gets created in budgies’ brains could help clarify what goes wrong in certain communication disorders in people.
Sign up for our newsletter
We summarize the week's science breakthroughs every Thursday.
Budgerigars (
Melopsittacus undulatus
) are tropical-colored,
smart
cutie pies. Beyond their looks, these parrots are particularly social and chatty, making them interesting research subjects for language studies.
Budgerigars have complex conversations, perhaps enabled by the “vocal keyboard” in their brains.
Long and his Langone Health colleague Zetian Yang tracked the behavior of individual nerve cells in four of these birds’ brains as they produced their chirrups. The activity of these cells, nestled in a part of the brain called the anterior arcopallium, is tied to the sounds the birds make, the duo found.
The organization of these neurons’ activity, it turns out, is pretty simple, Long says. He compares this neural organization to a keyboard that can produce a range of sounds — consonants, vowels, high pitches and low pitches. A budgie “is able to generate arbitrary sounds in its universe by just playing this vocal keyboard,” Long says. Overall, this flexible system has a humanlike organization.
The similarities
between human and parrot brains
may reflect two species solving a problem in a similar way, neurally speaking. These parallels could be “a very tidy example of convergent evolution, where you have humans that have developed this kind of neural mechanism for speech, and these parrots have developed a kind of similar mechanism,” Long says.
Now that scientists know more about how budgie brains help the birds talk, another question dogs Long: What are these parrots talking about?
“We are trying now to translate budgie,” he says, using advanced machine learning to determine what each warble and chirp means. Perhaps their language itself — not just the way their brain creates it — is similar to that of people. With these kinds of experiments, Long says, “maybe we can start to reexamine the notions of human exceptionalism.”

data.title: Train and Weather Tracker with Raspberry Pi and E-Ink
data.author: tosh
data.article_summary: 这篇文章介绍了一个使用Raspberry Pi和电子墨水屏构建的火车与天气追踪器项目。作者为了方便自己和妻子每天早上快速查看即将到来的地铁F线和G线的到站时间以及天气情况，开发了这个设备。该设备使用9.7英寸电子墨水屏和Raspberry Pi 4b，显示内容包括日期、时间、实时秒针、未来30分钟的火车到站时间、通勤天气以及未来12小时的天气预报。设备通过MTA API获取火车到站信息，并能以较为精准的时间显示即将到来的列车。软件部分包括显示引擎、布局系统、数据服务和应用控制器，采用了模块化架构。由于电子墨水屏的刷新率限制，作者采用了混合更新策略以减少鬼影现象并确保显示正常工作。整个项目代码和说明可以在GitHub上找到。

43517439.article_content:
Train & Weather Tracker with Raspberry Pi & E-Ink
March 2, 2025
Art
,
Physical
,
Software
I finally built a Raspberry Pi project my wife loves: an e-ink train and weather tracker! If you want to build one yourself,
the Github & instructions are here.
Kira will be jogging to the night shift!
Over the past few years, I've been on something of an e-ink journey.  I started with a
weather and news display
(still the only post on my website that regularly gets organic traffic.) While I loved it and it looked great, a phone is a better way to check the news, and the weather only gets checked once a day. Then in 2022 while at MIT I built
Jarvis, the e-ink voice-to-image display
. Jarvis was a great party trick — say, "Hey Jarvis, paint me an elephant on a bowling ball in Times Square" and watch as the image gradually appeared. Notably, this was before ChatGPT, when people were still impressed by AI!
Jarvis live demo is better!
Then over Thanksgiving, I had some free time, a basket of spare parts, and the itch to code and build something physical. So here we are with the e-ink train and weather tracker.
The idea is simple: Every morning, my wife and I take the inbound F or G subway lines to work from a stop that's a 2-minute jog or a 6-minute walk from our house. I love the NYC subway and it works incredibly well, but the trains come
often
and
predictably
, not
on-a-schedule
. So every morning we're calling out, when's the next G, when's the next F — and one of us pulls out a phone for the MTA app or Google Maps and yells back the upcoming train times. Then we time our morning routines to either stretch for a train in three minutes or slow down for a train in ten.
The subway and weather tracker makes checking train times much faster and calmer than pulling out a phone. Since it's centrally located in our home, someone is always close enough to glance at it.
The subway times reported by the
MTA API
are reliable once the train is within a few stops or 15 minutes away, with precision increasing as the trains get closer. Having the train times on the wall lets you check how your morning routine is developing against the train schedule as the departure time gets closer.
Best of all, Kira loves it! This goes on my DIY pantheon along with adding legs to her dresser to make it a better height and fixing a towel rack right before she hosted her colleagues for a book club.
If you want to build one yourself or better understand the project, I'll dive into some editorial and gotchas below. The practical instructions, parts, and code live in this
GitHub Repo
.
Description & Features
The train & weather tracker is built on a
9.7" 1200x825 E-Ink display
attached to a
Raspberry Pi 4b
. The display is split into four parts: a header, with date, time, and a live second hand to indicate liveness; a train tracker; the commute weather; and a "weather bar" displaying the next 12 hours of weather. The main focus of the layout is the train tracker, which shows the upcoming 30 minutes of inbound F & G trains.
The display sits in a laser cut mat board with black ridges sized to hide the black border of the e-ink display. The mat board sits in a 8.5" x 11" cherry frame that is 1.5" deep to allow the raspberry pi to be backmounted while the frame is still flush to the wall. We hang the display next to the door above a key holder, which is generally the right place for it, but also helps hide the power cord.
Not pretty, but it works
Project Details
The software portion of the project is manageable although there are some gotchas when programming against the Waveshare e-ink hat in particular. We have a modular architecture with a clear separation of concerns:
Display Engine: Renders the layout to the display, supporting communication with the physical e-ink display or rendering a png for non-raspberry pi development
Layout System: A pretty hacky visual arrangement of the elements. It'd be fun to do something more sophisticated here (e.g. a html renderer), but 🤷‍♂️. This will likely require the most work if you want to modify the project
Data Services: Fetch & process (this is important!) train arrival from NYC Transit GTFS feeds + get the weather forecasts
Application Controller: Orchestrate the event loop and subscription model to drive updates to the display
The biggest technical constraint is the update rate to the e-ink display. The display supports multiple update modes with different tradeoffs and
can
manage sub 500 ms updates, especially for partial updates, but a faster refresh results in fuzzy characters and substantial ghosting that looks pretty bad. The bigger issue is that overloading the display causes it to crash, which requires a full reset.
After some testing, I chose a hybrid display update strategy.
Every second, the pixels around the seconds & minutes digits of the time are rerendered with the display's fastest partial update mode to make it clear that the display is functioning as expected.
