FOLLOW
news article
Based on facts, either observed and verified firsthand by the reporter, or reported and verified from knowledgeable sources.
Share
Copy Link
✓ Link copied to clipboard!
Republican lawmakers in Arkansas have introduced a bill that would allow lawsuits against anyone who facilitates a minor's social transition — including hairdressers and barbers who give gender-nonconforming haircuts, teachers who use a student's chosen name that is different from their birth name and nonprofit organizations that offer support.
House Bill 1668, known as the "Vulnerable Youth Protection Act," was introduced by
Republican
Rep. Mary Bentley and Sen. Alan Clark. If passed, the legislation would allow parents to sue anyone who supports a minor's gender transition, with the statute of limitations lasting for 15 years.
The Context
Arkansas has been a leader in legislative efforts restricting transgender rights. In 2021, it became the first state to ban gender-affirming medical care for minors—a law that was struck down by a federal judge in 2023. Since then, more than two dozen states have enacted similar measures limiting medical care, sports participation and bathroom access for transgender individuals.
Nationally, transgender rights have
become a flashpoint
in the country's culture wars. Some political analysts have suggested the backlash against these rights—embodied in
the most viral ad
of the presidential campaign—played a decisive role in
Donald Trump
's victory.
What To Know
The Arkansas bill defines "social transitioning" as any act in which a minor adopts a gender identity different from their biological sex, including changes in clothing, pronouns, hairstyle and name. Under this definition, a barber, teacher or guidance counselor could face lawsuits for supporting a child's gender identity.
It allows lawsuits to be filed up to 15 years after an incident, with damages ranging from $10,000 to $10 million in cases where a minor received gender-affirming care.
Critics argue the bill violates First Amendment rights and is designed to intimidate teachers, doctors, and even parents from supporting transgender and gender-nonconforming youth. The American Civil Liberties Union (ACLU) of Arkansas has condemned it as "state-mandated bullying."
The bill would allow lawsuits against individuals who facilitate a minor's social transition, including hairdressers who give gender-nonconforming haircuts
The bill would allow lawsuits against individuals who facilitate a minor's social transition, including hairdressers who give gender-nonconforming haircuts
Getty Images
Supporters claim the measure is necessary to prevent children from making irreversible decisions about their gender identity, while opponents see it as a direct attack on the rights of transgender youth and those who support them.
At a March 18 hearing, however, a representative from the Arkansas Attorney General's Office acknowledged that parts of the bill may not withstand legal challenges due to restrictions on free speech.
"When you are criminalizing or, in this case, providing a civil cause of action for certain forms of speech, that has to pass a very, very high constitutional bar, and we have to be able to defend that in court," the representative said.
What People Are Saying
Mary Bentley, Arkansas GOP State Representative, in a House Judiciary hearing
: "This is about protecting children from being pushed into gender ideology. We need to ensure that kids are not being coerced into decisions they do not understand."
The ACLU of Arkansas in a statement
: "This bill seeks to deter life-saving healthcare through baseless lawsuits, forcing transgender youth into unsafe conditions."
What Happens Next
The bill is still moving through the Arkansas legislature and is expected to face immediate legal challenges if it is passed into law. Civil rights groups, educators, and LGBTQ+ advocates say they will continue fighting the bill.

主要讨论点：Windows系统的安装、配置和优化技巧，特别是如何避免安装不必要的软件（crapware）、优化系统设置以及使用第三方工具进行定制化。

不同观点：
• **chem83**：提出通过使用英文（世界）语言安装Windows以避免自动安装不必要的软件，并分享了在首次启动后更改语言仍会导致垃圾软件安装的经验。
• **juujian**：批评Windows系统需要大量变通方法，表达了对系统复杂性的不满。
• **atVelocet**：提供了多个详细的系统优化建议，包括使用LTSC或IoT/Enterprise版本、使用NTLite工具、配置GroupPolicies、集成驱动程序、安装防火墙等。强调通过正确配置GroupPolicies可以有效优化Windows系统。
• **j1elo**：列举了一系列希望通过.reg文件生成器实现的系统设置，如显示文件扩展名、使用经典右键菜单等。
• **cwillu**：关注如何关闭粘滞键快捷键，表达了对新机器上频繁误触该功能的不满。
• **_JamesA_**：分享了使用生成器在VMWare Workstation中部署Windows 11 Enterprise虚拟机的经验，表示效果很好。
• **teknopaul**：建议为.deb文件创建类似的工具，以便更容易配置和优化Debian系系统。
• **ralphc**：质疑这种方法对于普通用户购买新笔记本后的实用性，并询问“无网络”技巧是否仍然有效。
• **nullwarp**：表示对该工具的赞赏，但未提出具体观点。
• **CSDude**：喜欢使用纯色背景，并特别提到Windows 95背景颜色。
• **theandrewbailey**：分享了使用unattend.xml文件将用户文件夹放置在硬盘上的经验，尽管文档警告不要这样做，但他多年使用并无问题。
• **kalev**：询问是否可以通过该方法禁用Autopilot/MDM。
• **nicman23**：请求添加Enterprise IoT版本的支持。
• **7bit**：认为应该使用Windows ADK进行专业配置，对该工具表示不屑，认为其无用。

补充讨论：
• 争议焦点之一是普通用户在购买新笔记本后的操作复杂性，以及“无网络”技巧的有效性。
• 不同用户对系统优化工具的看法不一，有人认为这些工具非常有用，而有人（如7bit）则认为专业用户应使用Windows ADK进行配置。
• 讨论中还涉及了如何有效配置Windows以避免不必要的功能和软件，以及如何通过第三方工具或手动配置实现系统优化。

data.title: Why do we need modules at all? (2011)
data.author: matthews2
data.article_summary: 本文讨论了是否需要在编程语言中使用模块，提出了一种不同的编程方式。作者Joe Armstrong建议取消模块，所有函数拥有唯一名称和丰富的元数据，并存储在一个全局的可搜索键值数据库中。这种方式的优点包括简化代码贡献，只需添加单个函数，而不是完整的项目，同时内容经过同行评审。作者还提到当前模块系统的优缺点，例如模块提供了编译和代码分发的单元，但决定函数归属模块常常很困难，且可能破坏封装。他以Erlang中的`lists.erl`和`string.erl`为例，说明在多个模块中选择合适的一个放置函数的困惑，并介绍了自己在`elib1_misc.erl`中积累的常用函数。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：关于是否需要模块和层次命名空间的争论

不同观点：
• **支持模块和层次命名空间**：
  - **ludston**：认为模块有助于避免搜索结果被无关代码污染，帮助组织核心功能，避免过长的函数名前缀，如匈牙利命名法。
  - **bionhoward**：模块限制了开发者在同一时间需要处理的复杂性，符合人类记忆限制（7±2概念）。
  - **layer8**：模块不仅能将协同工作的函数组合在一起，还能隐藏实现细节（私有函数），并作为版本控制的基本单位。

• **支持扁平命名空间**：
  - **Joe**：Erlang社区成员，支持扁平命名空间，认为层次命名没有逻辑性且不扩展，用例子（啤酒和薯条）说明扁平命名足够。
  - **jasode**：指出即使没有模块，大型代码库中会通过元数据标签等方式重新发明层次结构，但扁平命名迫使函数名唯一，可能导致名称过长。

• **中立或反思性观点**：
  - **jonnycat**：虽然不完全同意反对层次命名空间的观点，但尊重提出者的专业知识，倾向于倾听和学习。
  - **andrewcl**：认为设想无模块的世界有其价值，但难以实际实现，模块作为分隔手段有其必要性。

补充讨论：
• **Unison语言的提及**：
  - **anonzzzies**和**neongreen**：提到Unison语言使用函数数据库和自由重命名标识符，可能解决部分命名空间问题。

• **对扁平命名空间的批评**：
  - **Etheryte**：质疑扁平命名空间只是将复杂性转移，而非解决，在海量函数中寻找特定函数变得困难。
  - **immibis**：通过JavaScript的npm生态系统例子，说明单一扁平命名空间会导致混乱和管理问题。

• **安全性和动态加载**：
  - **friendzis**：提出全局命名空间可能导致安全问题，特别是在动态加载代码时，模块有助于限制变更的影响范围。

• **对高级功能的设想**：
  - **wruza**：认为函数多分类、搜索等高级功能过于理想化，现实中实现难度大。

争议的焦点：模块和层次命名空间是否必要，扁平命名空间是否能有效管理大型代码库的复杂性。

Why do we need modules at all?
This is a brain-dump-stream-of-consciousness-thing. I've been
thinking about this for a while.
I'm proposing a slightly different way of programming here
The basic idea is
- do away with modules
- all functions have unique distinct names
- all functions have (lots of) meta data
- all functions go into a global (searchable) Key-value database
- we need letrec
- contribution to open source can be as simple as
contributing a single function
- there are no "open source projects" - only "the open source
Key-Value database of all functions"
- Content is peer reviewed
These are discussed in no particular order below:
Why does Erlang have modules?
There's a good an bad side to modules:
Good: Provides a unit of compilation, a unit of code
distribution. unit of code replacement
Bad: It's very difficult to decide which module to put an individual
function in. Break encapsulation (see later)
Aside: lib_misc.erl
When I'm programming I often get to the point were I say there should
a function foo/2 in lists.erl but their isn't. There should be but
there isn't - foo/2 is a small self contained thing. Why should it be
in lists.erl because it "feels right".
Strings are lists, so why do we have two modules lists.erl and
string.erl how should I decide in which module my new string/list
processing function should go.
To avoid all mental anguish when I need a small function that
should be somewhere else and isn't I stick it in
a module elib1_misc.erl.

data.title: Show HN: Transputer emulator in JavaScript (fast enough to be useful)
data.author: nanochess
data.article_summary: 这篇文章介绍了作者使用Javascript实现的一个Transputer处理器模拟器。该模拟器最初是用C语言编写的，并为适应Javascript做了一些调整，如处理32位无符号整数和使用Uint8Array提高性能和内存效率。模拟器预装了作者1996年开发的操作系统，支持多驱动器和C编译器（K&R语法），并提供了一些示例命令和程序编译方法。此外，模拟器还支持运行3D建模和光线追踪程序，并展示了多任务处理的简单例子。文章最后提供了源代码链接，并邀请读者支持其创作。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：对一个90年代西班牙语DOS系统及其技术背景的评价

不同观点：
• Vessenes认为这个项目非常有趣和酷，特别是将DOS转译成JavaScript，并且整个系统由一位西班牙母语者在90年代编写，所有提示和命令都是西班牙语，比如使用“AYUDA”（帮助）。他强调了这种个性化创作带来的拥有感，尤其是作者在青少年时期完成的，让人感到非常有趣和独特。

• Fidotron则更关注技术背景，指出该项目没有提到Occam语言和Transputer的微码指令，尤其是关于通道的部分。他认为Transputer作为高性能设计的初衷常常被忽视，而浮点单元的开发是整个项目中最成功的部分之一。Fidotron认为令人印象深刻的并不是模拟器本身，而是其他相关技术成就，比如在90年代墨西哥作为一个青少年为Transputer编写Pascal编译器，这是非常了不起的。

补充讨论：
• Vessenes的观点更多集中在文化背景和个性化创作带来的情感共鸣，特别是西班牙语命令和青少年作者的身份。
• Fidotron的观点更偏向技术细节和历史背景，强调了Transputer和Occam语言在当时的重要性，并对项目中未提及这些内容感到遗憾。
• 争议的焦点可能在于对项目亮点的不同看法：Vessenes更欣赏个性化和文化元素，而Fidotron则更看重技术深度和历史准确性。

总结来看，评论中对该DOS系统的评价存在两种不同的视角，一种强调个人情感和文化背景，另一种则关注技术实现和历史背景。

Transputer emulator in Javascript
This is a Javascript port of my
transputer emulator written originally in C
for my series of articles about the transputer processor. In the old times, Javascript was an interpreted language, but since many years ago it is implemented as a JIT (Just-In-Time) compiler, so it can approach speeds closer to the C language.
Other implementation caveat here is that Javascript treats bitwise operators as generating 32-bit signed integers. This was avoided using the
>>> 0
operator (logical right-shift) because it generates a 32-bit
unsigned
integer. You can try
0x80000000 >> 0
and see how it gives back a negative number, while
0x80000000 >>> 0
preserves the unsigned value.
Another "new" thing in Javascript is
Uint8Array
, it is way faster than a normal array and
saves
memory, as there are several of these arrays (including one of 40MB to hold the entire hard disk drive!). For the drive images, I tried using an initialized array but the source code used 20 megabytes for a binary of 3 megabytes. I figured a good trick to reduce the Javascript source code size using
Base64 in my bin2.c utility
to encode the 3MB of data for the hard disk drive, and
window.atob
gets a decoded string that is copied directly to the hard disk drive's Uint8Array.
I didn't expected to have a floating-point emulation, but I discovered the
Float32Array
and Float64Array types (added in 2010) and how these can be shadowed with an Uint32Array, so the emulator can work with real floating-point math, and uses the Uint32Array to get the floating-point binary data to replicate in the transputer internal memory.
Finally, for the display I was pretty fortunate to find
jsTerm by Peter Nitsch
with a compatible license. I removed the Telnet and sockets portion. And as it used a bitmap for the font, I was able to replace it with my original font from 1996 and use it, so you can see the single-line borders for the text windows, and other special characters. My font was based on ECMA-94 (charset 1), also known as ISO-8859-1, with the $00-$1f and $80-$9f characters filled with graphics. It is based on a VGA BIOS font, and I think I improved some letters, but I don't remember which ones. Try running the
C:Conjunto
command to see all the letters and symbols.
You can give a look to the Javascript source code for this emulator at
https://github.com/nanochess/transputer/tree/master/js
What do we have here?
This emulator doesn't have options to run
my early Pascal compiler
or the
Small-C compiler
, instead it comes preloaded with
my full-blown operating system
(Spring 1996), it includes a lot of features like multiple drives (A: is a 1.44mb floppy, B: is a 512K RAM disk, C: is a 40 MB hard drive, D: is a CD-ROM in ISO-9660 format but no image can be loaded).
The C compiler supports the full K&R syntax (except for
static
and
extern
, because there's no linker).
Some commands you can test inside the operating system:
DIR A:
DIR C:
AYUDA
MEM
C:EDITOR
Use F1 (or Fn+F1 in macOS) to access the help box of the visual text editor, and type F4 (or Fn+F4 in macOS) to open the directory browsing for reading text files.
Use
C:CC
to invoke the C compiler,
C:ENS
to invoke the assembler,
C:EJECUTABLE
to build assembler output into a working executable. There are instructions for compiling programs in the
C:/Documentos/Programas.doc
file (you could try self-compiling the C compiler!)
This is an example compilation of a program:
C:CC
N
N
C:/C/Hora.c
B:Hora.len
C:ENS
B:Hora.len
C:/Lib/stdio.len
[empty line]
B:Hora.e
C:EJECUTABLE

512

C:Hora.p
My emulator in C is way faster than this demo, but if you have a speedy computer and a good browser, this Javascript version can be very interesting.
3D modeler
You can run the 3D modeler using this:
c:modela
c:dibujo_3d/escena_tetera
Select a mode, press Enter, and then press Enter again to start displaying. There are more scenes in the
C:/Dibujo_3D
directory, each one starts with the name

dir c:/dibujo_3d/escena*

Multitasking
There is a small example of multitasking, you can have a clock at the top-right of the screen. Type this command:
@c:/Desarrollo/Reloj

43578190.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：对一个90年代西班牙语DOS系统及其技术背景的评价

不同观点：
• Vessenes认为这个项目非常有趣和酷，特别是将DOS转译成JavaScript，并且整个系统由一位西班牙母语者在90年代编写，所有提示和命令都是西班牙语，比如使用“AYUDA”（帮助）。他强调了这种个性化创作带来的拥有感，尤其是作者在青少年时期完成的，让人感到非常有趣和独特。

• Fidotron则更关注技术背景，指出该项目没有提到Occam语言和Transputer的微码指令，尤其是关于通道的部分。他认为Transputer作为高性能设计的初衷常常被忽视，而浮点单元的开发是整个项目中最成功的部分之一。Fidotron认为令人印象深刻的并不是模拟器本身，而是其他相关技术成就，比如在90年代墨西哥作为一个青少年为Transputer编写Pascal编译器，这是非常了不起的。

补充讨论：
• Vessenes的观点更多集中在文化背景和个性化创作带来的情感共鸣，特别是西班牙语命令和青少年作者的身份。
• Fidotron的观点更偏向技术细节和历史背景，强调了Transputer和Occam语言在当时的重要性，并对项目中未提及这些内容感到遗憾。
• 争议的焦点可能在于对项目亮点的不同看法：Vessenes更欣赏个性化和文化元素，而Fidotron则更看重技术深度和历史准确性。

总结来看，评论中对该DOS系统的评价存在两种不同的视角，一种强调个人情感和文化背景，另一种则关注技术实现和历史背景。

data.title: Welcome to the Semantic Apocalypse
data.author: paulpauper
data.article_summary: 文章讨论了AI技术带来的“语义末日”（semantic apocalypse），即艺术和语言的意义被逐渐抽空。作者埃里克·霍尔在2019年曾预测，AI将导致这种现象，并在看到GPT-2生成的诗歌时加深了这一担忧。如今，随着AI生成图像和创意写作模型的发布，这一预言似乎正在实现。特别是Studio Ghibli风格的照片在网络上泛滥，虽然有趣，但也引发了人们对原创艺术意义被稀释的忧虑。OpenAI似乎刻意模仿某些艺术家，如宫崎骏和纳博科夫，尽管这些模仿未达完美，但足以让人们对原作失去珍视。文章警示，这种“接近但非完美”的复制可能正在改变人们对艺术的根本认知。

Welcome to the semantic apocalypse
Studio Ghibli style and the draining of meaning
Erik Hoel

1,669

A photo of my kids reading, transformed Studio Ghibli style by an AI (the AI flipped the book upside down).
An awful personal prophecy is coming true. Way back in 2019, when AI was still a relatively niche topic, and only the primitive GPT-2 had been released, I predicted the technology would usher in a “semantic apocalypse” wherein art and language were drained of meaning. In fact, it was the
first essay
ever posted here on
The Intrinsic Perspective
.
I saw the dystopian potential for the future the exact moment I read a certain line in Kane Hsieh’s now-forgotten experiment,
Transformer Poetry
,
where he published poems written by GPT-2. Most weren’t good, but at a certain point the machine wrote:
Thou hast not a thousand days to tell me thou art beautiful.
I read that line and thought: “Fuck.”
Fast forward six years, and the semantic apocalypse has started in earnest. People now report experiencing the exact internal psychological change I predicted about our collective consciousness all those years ago.
Just two days ago, OpenAI released their latest image generation model, with capabilities far more potent than the technology was even a year ago. Someone tweeted out the new AI could be used as a “Studio Ghibli style” filter for family photos. 20 million views later,
everything
online was Studio Ghibli.
source
Every meme was redone Ghibli-style, family photos were now in Ghibli-style, anonymous accounts face-doxxed themselves Ghibli-style. And it’s undeniable that Ghiblification is fun. I won’t lie. That picture of my kids reading together above, which is from a real photo—I exclaimed in delight when it appeared in the chat window like magic. So I totally get it. It’s a softer world when you have Ghibli glasses on. But by the time I made the third picture, it was less fun. A creeping sadness set in.
source
The internet’s Ghiblification was not an accident. Changing a photo
into an anime style
was specifically featured in OpenAI’s original announcement.
Why? Because OpenAI does, or at least seems to do, something arguably kind of evil: they train their models to specifically imitate the artists the model trainers themselves like. Miyazaki for anime seems a strong possibility, but the same thing just happened with their new creative writing bot, which (ahem, it appears) was trained to mimic Nabokov.
While that creative-writing bot is still not released, it was previewed earlier this month, when Sam Altman
posted
a short story it wrote. It went viral because, while the story was clearly over-written (a classic beginner’s error), there were indeed some good metaphors in there, including when the AI mused:
I am nothing if not a democracy of ghosts.
Too good, actually. It sounded eerily familiar to me. I checked, and yup, that’s lifted directly from Nabokov.
Pnin slowly walked under solemn pines. The sky was dying. He did not believe in an autocratic God. He did believe, dimly, in a democracy of ghosts.
The rest of the story reads as a mix of someone aping Nabokov and Murakami—authors who
just so happen
to be personal favorites of some of the team members who worked on the project. Surprise, surprise.
Similarly, the new image model is a bit worse at other anime styles. But for Studio Ghibli, while I wouldn’t go so far as to say it’s passable, it’s also not
super far
from passable for
some
scenes. The AI can’t hold all the signature Ghibli details in mind—its limitation remains its intelligence and creativity, not its ability to copy style. Below on the left is a scene that took a real Studio Ghibli artist
15 months to complete
. On the right is what I prompted in 30 seconds.
Studio Ghibli (left); the scene re-created using ChatGPT (right)
In the AI version, the action is all one way, so it lacks the original’s complexity and personality, failing to capture true chaos. I’m not saying it’s a perfect copy. But the 30 seconds vs. 15 months figure should give everyone pause.
The irony of internet Ghiblification is that Miyazaki is well-known for his hatred of AI, remarking once in a documentary that:
source
While ChatGPT can’t pull off a perfect Miyazaki copy, it doesn’t really matter. The semantic apocalypse doesn’t require AI art to be exactly as good as the best human art. You just need to flood people with close-enough creations such that the originals feel less meaningful.
source
Many people are reporting that their mental relationship to art is changing; that as fun as it is to Ghibli-fy at will, something fundamental has been cheapened about the original. Here’s someone describing their internal response to this cultural “grey goo.”
source

data.title: Multi-Token Attention
data.author: fzliu
data.article_summary: 本文提出了一种新的注意力机制，称为多token注意力（Multi-Token Attention, MTA），以解决传统注意力机制仅依赖单一查询和键向量相似度的问题。MTA通过在查询、键和头之间应用卷积操作，使得相邻的查询和键能够相互影响注意力权重，从而更精准地定位相关信息。实验表明，MTA在多种基准测试中表现优异，尤其在需要处理长文本的任务中，效果显著优于Transformer基线模型。这种方法能够利用更丰富和细致的信息，提升语言模型的性能。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：Facebook提出的Transformer架构改进及其相关技术讨论

不同观点：
• [kouteiheika] 认为，该改进虽然在Transformer架构上有潜在提升，但由于修改了注意力机制的内核，导致与Flash Attention等优化库不兼容，实际应用中性能损失过大，难以在实际中使用，除非有如FlexAttention这样的工具完善。
• [bionhoward] 将该改进与Byte Latent Transformer (BLT) 进行比较，指出该方法在嵌入时应用注意力，而BLT在嵌入后应用卷积，存在实现方式的区别。
• [bigdict] 质疑该方法是否在等量计算资源下能提升性能，即是否能在不增加计算资源的前提下提高效率。
• [bob1029] 提出该方法可能导致计算复杂度以二次方增长，尤其是在内存带宽利用上可能成为瓶颈。
• [rakejake] 分享了在音频分类任务中的实验经验，尝试了多种模型如CNN-GRU、MultiHeadAttention等，最终发现MultiHeadAttention效果最好，但内存消耗大。
• [fabmilo] 认为当前的Tokenization方法只是局部优化，AI能力的进一步提升需要超越Tokenization的方法。
• [cgearhart] 质疑引入局部窗口是否合理，认为注意力机制本应解决长距离依赖问题，回归局部窗口是倒退。
• [curiousfiddler] 质疑该方法是否比多头注意力提取更多语义信息，并将其与CNN中多类型滤波器进行类比。
• [jwilber] 对卷积操作在LLM中的复兴表示兴趣，并提到striped hyena架构的成功应用。
• [antonkar] 提出将GPUs置于国际科学家控制下的云端以防止AI滥用的设想，并认为这是一个潜在的商业机会。

补充讨论：
• 评论中涉及的具体技术包括Flash Attention、FlexAttention、Byte Latent Transformer、CNN-GRU、MultiHeadAttention、conv-based hyena operator等。
• 争议焦点在于该改进方法的实际应用可行性、计算复杂度、内存消耗以及是否能真正提升性能。
• 部分评论者如[fabmilo]和[cgearhart]对当前技术路线提出质疑，认为需要更根本性的创新。

(cs)
[Submitted on 1 Apr 2025]
Title:
Multi-Token Attention
Authors:
Olga Golovneva
,
Tianlu Wang
,
Jason Weston
,
Sainbayar Sukhbaatar
View a PDF of the paper titled Multi-Token Attention, by Olga Golovneva and 3 other authors
View PDF
HTML (experimental)
Abstract:
Soft attention is a critical mechanism powering LLMs to locate relevant parts within a given context. However, individual attention weights are determined by the similarity of only a single query and key token vector. This "single token attention" bottlenecks the amount of information used in distinguishing a relevant part from the rest of the context. To address this issue, we propose a new attention method, Multi-Token Attention (MTA), which allows LLMs to condition their attention weights on multiple query and key vectors simultaneously. This is achieved by applying convolution operations over queries, keys and heads, allowing nearby queries and keys to affect each other's attention weights for more precise attention. As a result, our method can locate relevant context using richer, more nuanced information that can exceed a single vector's capacity. Through extensive evaluations, we demonstrate that MTA achieves enhanced performance on a range of popular benchmarks. Notably, it outperforms Transformer baseline models on standard language modeling tasks, and on tasks that require searching for information within long contexts, where our method's ability to leverage richer information proves particularly beneficial.

data.author: belter
data.article_summary: 文章主要报道了唐纳德·特朗普宣布对多国加征关税后，全球市场的反应。美国股市遭遇自2020年疫情以来最糟糕的一天，道琼斯、纳斯达克和标普指数均大幅下跌。加拿大宣布对美国进口车辆加征25%关税，英国也准备了一份可能加征关税的400页美国产品清单。墨西哥则表示不会采取报复措施。此外，文章探讨了关税对美国消费者和产品的影响，以及全球其他国家如何应对特朗普的关税政策。印度等国也在评估关税对其经济的影响，并寻找机会。文章最后提到，市场动荡可能带来新的机遇。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：美国贸易政策及其影响，特别是关税政策对经济、社会和国际关系的影响。

不同观点：
• **关税对经济的整体影响**：
  - **[svara]**：认为自由贸易对美国整体经济有利，但会导致不平等。解决方法应包括降低教育成本、建立社会系统和选择性投资于战略性行业，而非伤害整体经济。
  - **[lumb63]**：虽然关税政策有缺点，但可以解决国内生产者因全球化失去竞争力的问题，并有助于减少贸易逆差和国家债务。
  - **[lifeinthevoid]**：认为美国一直是世界上最好的经商之地，关税政策不合理，是一种专制行为。

• **关税对消费者的直接影响**：
  - **[TrackerFF]**：指出取消最低豁免将导致所有从中国进口的商品被加征30%的进口税，消费者最终会收到额外账单，可能引发混乱。
  - **[roxolotl]**：指出某些商品（如来自突尼斯的橄榄油）被加征高额关税，而这些商品并没有美国国内生产者受益，无法作为保护措施辩护。
  - **[phillipseamore]**：提到本地生产商可能利用关税提高价格，导致消费者即使面对进口商品涨价也无法受益。

• **关税对制造业和劳动力市场的影响**：
  - **[iteratethis]**：认为关税不会带来制造业回流，因为美国缺乏足够的劳动力，特别是在军事、建筑和汽车等行业存在大量未填补的职位。
  - **[ggm]**：指出政府明白关税政策的经济后果，并有意通过经济重置来解决债务问题，但这种策略有风险且时间线不明。

• **关税与国际关系和债务问题**：
  - **[TaurenHunter]**：强调美国需要管理其庞大的国家债务，关税可能通过影响美联储政策降低利率，但也可能引发债务螺旋风险。
  - **[doener]**：引用一种关税计算公式，认为关税实际上是基于贸易逆差计算的。
  - **[ryzvonusef]**：提到关税政策对其他国家的影响，即使是与美国产业没有直接竞争的国家也可能受到波及。

补充讨论：
• **可能的国际反制措施**：
  - **[Gasp0de]**：提到欧盟可能通过不执行美国知识产权或对云公司征税来报复关税政策。

• **对关税政策的质疑和数据分析**：
  - **[mcoliver]**：提供数据分析，指出关税实际上是贸易不平衡百分比，而非传统的关税，质疑关税政策的合理性。

争议焦点：
• 关税政策的短期和长期经济影响，特别是对消费者和制造业的影响。
• 关税是否能有效解决不平等和国家债务问题，还是只会引发更多问题。
• 关税政策对国际关系的影响及可能的反制措施。

Summary
Wall Street suffers its worst day since 2020
after Donald Trump announced a raft of worldwide tariffs last night
In Canada, Prime Minister Mark Carney announces
25% tariffs on certain US vehicles
The UK has drawn up a
400-page list of US products
it could hit with tariffs -
Henry Zeffman says
it is a toughening up of Starmer's stance
Trump announced 10% tariffs on most countries
- including the UK - from Saturday,  with higher rates on some of America's biggest trading partners from 9 April.
We cover the basics in five key questions here
As part of
Your Voice, Your BBC News
, our experts are answering your questions - including
whether the UK is enjoying a "Brexit benefit"
as well as the impact of tariffs on
US customers
and
products
Media caption,
How the US stock market is reacting to Trumpâs tariffsâ¦in 45 seconds
Live Reporting
Edited by Emily McGarvey
Jacqueline Howard
Live reporter
Image source,
Reuters
Image caption,
Trump arriving in Miami earlier today
As investors watched the US stock market take its
biggest one-day dive since the pandemic
in 2020, the message from the White House to Wall Street was: "
Trust in President Trump
".
Trump himself
said markets would "boom"
under his new tariff scheme as the Dow Jones, Nasdaq and S&P plunged over the course of the day.
Twenty-four hours after
Trump imposed minimum 10% import tariffs
worldwide starting on 5 April, the US's key trading partners are mapping out their response.
Canadian Prime Minister Mark Carney retaliated with
25% levies on all vehicles imported across the border
, lamenting that the close relationship with the US is "now over". In contrast, Mexican President Claudia Sheinbaum said her country
would not retaliate in kind
.
Meanwhile, the UK has drawn up a
400-page sample list of US goods
that could face future tariffs in retaliation to Trump's tariffs, and though EU leaders are yet to present the bloc's official response, many have slammed the tariffs as "
brutal
".
Eyes will be on the Asian markets in the coming hours as eastern trading floors reopen after
initial losses
immediately following Trump's announcement.
We are now ending our live coverage for the night, but will be back with you come morning. In the meantime, there is plenty about the impact of Trump's tariffs on offer across BBC News:

At a grocery store in Toronto, shopper Benedykta Mazur has become a bit of a sleuth.
Since Donald Trump launched a trade war with Canada, she has been trying to buy Canadian as much as possible. Some products, like fresh blueberries in April, are impossible.
But while sheâs willing to pick up something grown in Mexico or Chile, she draws a hard line at anything grown or manufactured in the US.
âIt's a no, an absolute no,â she tells me, after Trump announced his latest round of tariffs on the rest of the world.
âThis is something that is not going to be just kind of wishy washy,â she says.
Mazur says while Canadians have a reputation for being âreally niceâ, it is time to turn peopleâs charms elsewhere, and build partnerships with countries that âshare commonalities in regards to how you treat another person, because countries are made of peopleâ.

Rocco Mangiaracina runs a family business in Sicily
Rocco Mangiaracina is an agricultural
entrepreneur. His small family business based in Campobello di Mazara, Sicily,
produces around 20,000 bottles of olive oil a year.
This is the first year they've started exporting to the US.
âOnly a week ago, we sent our first 900 bottles to the American
market," he says, adding that he planned to send more bottles but was advised to wait and see how the situation develops.

bearing the extra costs, but for the importer - who was planning to place
another order soon, increase volumes, or expand the product range.
"Now the
importer is discouraged by the prospect of having to pay significantly more
and, as a result, being forced to raise the final price for consumers.
"This feels like a regression - putting up barriers whose usefulness I struggle to see."

data.title: .NET on Heroku Now Generally Available
data.author: runesoerensen
data.article_summary: .NET 支持在 Heroku 平台上已正式发布（Generally Available，GA），标志着 .NET 开发者可以在 Heroku 上获得全面支持的生产环境。.NET 生态系统现已成为 Heroku 的第七个运行时环境，开发者可以获得最新的 .NET 运行时和 SDK，自动构建和部署 .NET 应用（包括 C#、F# 和 Visual Basic）。Heroku 提供全面的文档和支持，适应 .NET 开发者的习惯和工作流程，支持多种部署模式和自动化任务，如数据库迁移和回滚。无论你是新用户还是从测试版过渡，Heroku 都提供了平滑的部署体验和工具，帮助 .NET 开发者更高效地构建和发布应用。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：围绕不同工具和方法部署 .NET 应用程序的讨论

不同观点：
• mythz：表示将继续使用 **Kamal**（https://kamal-deploy.org）工具来将 .NET Docker 应用程序部署到 **Hetzner Cloud**（https://cloud.hetzner.com）。这表明 mythz 对 Kamal 工具和 Hetzner Cloud 有一定的依赖和信任。

• bob1029：对不同的 .NET 部署模型（如 **self-contained**、**ReadyToRun** 和 **Native AOT**）进行了评论。他特别指出 **self-contained** 部署选项可能存在风险，因为这种方法允许将应用程序直接复制到任何云虚拟机上运行，并结合 **SQLite** 使用时，只需复制文件夹和重启进程，几乎不需要其他编排工作。这暗示 bob1029 认为这种简便性可能隐藏着潜在的复杂性和风险。

补充讨论：
• peterpost2：提到 **Heroku** 已被 **Salesforce** 收购的事实，但该评论并未直接参与部署工具或方法的讨论，只是提供了一个背景信息。

• stuaxo：提到自己误以为讨论的是 **.NET** 在 **Haiku** 操作系统上的部署，表明讨论中可能存在一些技术背景或工具的混淆。不过该评论未深入探讨具体部署方式。

争议焦点：
• bob1029 对 **self-contained** 部署方式的简便性表示了一定的担忧，认为其虽然操作简单，但可能存在潜在风险。而 mythz 则似乎更关注实际应用中的便捷性，继续使用 Kamal 和 Hetzner Cloud 进行部署。

总结：讨论主要围绕 .NET 应用程序的不同部署方式，尤其是 self-contained 方式的便捷性与潜在风险，以及具体工具（如 Kamal 和 Hetzner Cloud）的使用。

43554339.article_content:
.NET on Heroku: Now Generally Available
Posted by
Rune Soerensen
and
Terence Lee
Last Updated:
April 02, 2025
It's never been a more exciting time to be a .NET developer. With .NET (formerly known as .NET Core) approaching its
10-year anniversary this November
, the platform has evolved into a powerful, cross-platform ecosystem, embracing modern development practices and powering a vast array of applications.
Today, we're thrilled to announce that .NET support on Heroku,
previously in beta
, is now Generally Available (GA), marking a significant milestone for .NET developers on our platform. We want to thank our beta users for their invaluable feedback, which has helped us to refine and enhance the .NET experience on Heroku.
Key Benefits of .NET GA
With General Availability, .NET applications on Heroku are fully supported in production environments. This represents our long-term commitment to the .NET ecosystem, meaning you can rely on Heroku's robust infrastructure and support services for your critical .NET workloads.
.NET joins as our 7th runtime ecosystem on the Heroku platform. Like all of our other ecosystems, what this means for .NET developers:
You'll have access to the latest stable version of the .NET runtime the day it’s released.
Comprehensive documentation is available on the Heroku Dev Center, tailored specifically for .NET developers.
Our support team is here to help with your .NET deployments, and you’re covered by
Heroku’s support policy
.
You'll have a developer experience that feels native and follows idioms familiar to .NET developers.
General Availability signifies that .NET on Heroku is production-ready, fully supported, and seamlessly integrated into the Heroku ecosystem, providing .NET developers with a first-class experience.
Built for .NET
Heroku now supports .NET, including languages like C#, F#, and Visual Basic. Heroku automatically understands, builds, and deploys your .NET applications, applying smart defaults to simplify your workflow. However, if you need more control, you can easily override these defaults to tailor the environment to your specific requirements, ensuring you can focus on coding and innovation.
.NET on Heroku includes:
The most recent .NET SDK and runtimes are installed automatically based on your project’s
TargetFramework
. You can override that using a
global.json
file if needed.
ASP.NET Core apps are configured to listen on the right port by default. All executable project types, including Console and Worker Services, are detected during build. The build log shows helpful output that can easily be adapted to your own process types with Procfile for more control.
Heroku supports framework-dependent apps by default, allowing a solution with many projects to be efficiently supported. Other deployment models, such as self-contained, ReadyToRun, and highly optimized Native AOT, are also supported out of the box.
Whether you’re working with a single project or a solution that includes multiple apps, Heroku adapts to your setup in a way that feels intuitive and natural for .NET developers.
Stay in the Flow
Beyond the core support, .NET apps plug right into the developer workflow you expect.
Use Heroku Pipelines to manage staging and production environments.
Run tests automatically with Heroku CI, supporting any major .NET testing framework.
Preview pull requests with Review Apps - complete, disposable Heroku apps that spin up automatically for each GitHub PR.
Automate tasks like database migrations with Release Phase, scale dynos instantly as demand grows, and roll back to any previously released version if something goes wrong.
With Heroku, you get a smooth, automated, and collaborative .NET development experience, allowing you to release with confidence from coding to production.
Getting Started with .NET on Heroku
Wherever you are in your .NET journey, Heroku offers a smooth path to deployment:
New to Heroku?
Head over to our
.NET sign up page
for more information.
Ready to Deploy?
Start with our
Getting Started with .NET
tutorial for a step-by-step guide.
Already using the
heroku/dotnet
buildpack from the beta?
You’re already on the GA version - no changes needed.
Need More Info?
Check out the
.NET Support Reference
on Dev Center.
Using a Community Buildpack?
Continue to use it, or migrate to the official buildpack - migration guides are coming soon.
Migrating from Another Platform?
Reach out to
Heroku Support
- we're ready to help.
The Heroku platform now offers .NET developers the performance, reliability, scalability, and ease of use they expect.
Share your feedback
with us on GitHub and help shape the future of .NET on Heroku!
We’re thrilled to support the .NET community and can’t wait to see what you build next.
Originally published: April 02, 2025

data.title: Mac Numbers now supports LAMBDA functions and MAP
data.author: putzdown
data.article_summary: 本文介绍了表格中的公式与函数使用指南，涵盖公式概述、编辑、复制、引用单元格、使用字符串运算符和通配符等操作，以及处理公式错误和最佳实践。函数部分详细列出了按类别分类的各类函数，包括日期时间、财务、工程、逻辑信息、数值、统计和文本函数等。特别说明了MAP函数，它通过LAMBDA函数将数组中的每个值映射为新值，并返回新数组。文章还提供了具体示例帮助理解。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：用户对Numbers应用的看法和使用体验，以及与Excel等其他工具的比较

不同观点：
• **支持Numbers，认为其适合轻量使用**：robin_reala认为Numbers在进行快速CSV数据操作时非常方便，不需要专门写脚本，适合轻量使用。mritchie712则用Numbers作为待办事项列表管理工具，已经使用了十年，认为其功能足够满足个人需求。

• **质疑Numbers的适用范围和支持文档**：friendzis指出Apple支持页面不够具体，无法从支持文章中明确Numbers的适用范围。这反映出用户对官方文档不够详细的困惑。

• **Numbers在深度商业需求上的不足**：MobileVet认为Numbers虽然在视觉上很美观，但在深度商业需求上仍无法与Excel相比，导致其公司不得不购买Windows设备以满足会计需求。这说明Numbers在高端商业应用中仍有很大提升空间。

• **对Numbers的陌生或无法访问**：ZeroCool2u表示从未见过Numbers的样子，因为公司MacBook上一直被硬性屏蔽。这反映了部分用户因企业政策限制而无法使用Numbers的情况。

• **对特定功能的期待和比较**：asplake询问Numbers是否具备SPLIT和JOIN功能，这是Excel中长期缺乏的功能。praestigiare则指出Numbers在共享和协作上的不便，因为大多数人都使用Excel和Google Sheets，但他承认Numbers在处理CSV和其他文本数据时表现出色。

补充讨论：
• **对标题的误解**：username135对标题产生了误解，以为讨论的是MAC地址，这显示出不同技术背景用户对同一话题可能产生的不同联想。

• **其他技术话题的插入**：jwhiles提到曾担心讨论的是AWS中的Lambda，而soegaard则提供了一个与Danish用户相关的bug报告链接。这些评论虽然与Numbers不完全相关，但体现了讨论的分散性和多样性。

• **功能扩展的期望**：MartinMond简短地提到Numbers缺少约束求解器，这表明部分用户希望Numbers能增加更多高级功能以满足复杂需求。

争议的焦点：
• Numbers是否足够强大以应对深度商业需求，特别是在与Excel的对比中表现出不足。MobileVet的经历显示出在高端应用中Numbers仍无法替代Excel。

总体来看，讨论围绕Numbers的优缺点展开，重点在于其轻量使用的便捷性和高端商业应用中的不足。官方支持文档的不明确性也引发了一些用户的困惑。

data.title: Microsoft will kill Remote Desktop soon, insists you'll love replacement
data.author: taubek
data.article_summary: 微软将于5月27日停止支持Remote Desktop应用，并要求用户转移至其Windows App。Windows App于2024年推出，作为统一访问多个Windows服务的界面，包括Windows 365、Azure Virtual Desktop等。尽管微软称其为安全网关，但用户反馈褒贬不一，有人称其为“最愚蠢的更名”。迁移后，Remote Desktop应用将从微软商店下架，且无法通过它访问相关服务。Windows App支持多显示器、自定义主屏幕等功能，但不支持某些环境下的代理服务器认证和单点登录。现有Remote Desktop用户需在截止日期前完成迁移。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：微软将从Microsoft Store中移除Remote Desktop应用引发的不同观点和讨论。

不同观点：
• [Kwpolska] 认为这篇新闻有标题党嫌疑。微软只是从Microsoft Store中移除Remote Desktop应用，但不会删除大多数人使用的Remote Desktop Connection（mstsc.exe）。
• [candiddevmike] 批评微软在命名上的一贯混乱，认为其命名容易引起误解。
• [teeray] 关心在Linux上如何继续使用远程桌面连接。
• [biglyburrito] 通过讽刺表达对微软一些强制性更改的不满，如Windows 11任务栏、Copilot和强制创建微软账户。

补充讨论：
• [rikafurude21] 分享了自己放弃现代远程桌面工具，转向使用VNC的经验，并提到通过tailscale解决端口开放问题，认为核心功能并没有太大变化，除非需要极低延迟。
• [nottorp] 询问文中提到的Remote Desktop具体是指哪一个，并提到自己使用的是一个跨平台的远程桌面应用。
• [9cb14c1ec0] 推荐Rustdesk作为替代方案。
• [Pixelious] 认为Remote Desktop本来就不太好用，并预期Windows 11会带来更多令人不满的变化。
• [ReptileMan] 认为此举可能是为了增加AnyDesk的用户数量。
• [soco] 认为Microsoft Store整体在走下坡路，尤其是企业用户无法有效使用，并预测企业级应用（如365）会填补这一空缺。
• [jmclnx] 提到Linux曾强制推广Remote Desktop，而现在微软却要废弃它，质疑Linux是否会跟随微软转向其他方案。

争议焦点：
• 微软移除Remote Desktop应用是否会影响到用户的实际使用体验，尤其是跨平台用户（如Linux和Mac OS）。
• 微软命名和产品策略的混乱是否导致了用户的理解困难和不满。
• 微软在Windows 11中的一些强制性更改（如Copilot和微软账户）是否合理。

OSes
78
Microsoft will kill Remote Desktop soon, insists you'll love replacement
78
Windows App the way ahead as support pulled from May 27
Richard Speed
Tue 11 Mar 2025
//
18:03 UTC
The end is nigh for Microsoft's Remote Desktop application. The IT giant will pull support on May 27 when users must transition to the corp's Windows App, with all the positives and negatives that entails.
The Windows App
arrived in 2024
to a lukewarm reception. At the time, Microsoft said: "This unified app serves as your secure gateway to connect to Windows across Windows 365, Azure Virtual Desktop, Remote Desktop, Remote Desktop Services, Microsoft Dev Box, and more."
Effectively, it's the Remote Desktop app in new clothes. Or as Microsoft
put it
: "Unified access to multiple Windows services, including Cloud PCs and virtual desktops from a single, streamlined interface."
One user called it "the dumbest rebranding ever."
However, the writing was on the wall for the Remote Desktop app, and on May 27, the code will be removed from the Microsoft Store. Need to access Windows 365, Azure Virtual Desktop, or Microsoft Dev Box? You'll need to use the Windows App... until Microsoft rebrands again and finds a way of shoehorning the word "Copilot" in there.
Eight days later, Microsoft's Outlook users on iOS devices still struggling
Microsoft admits GitHub hosted malware that infected almost a million devices
Microsoft tells abandoned Publisher fans to just use Word and hope for the best
Microsoft goes native with Copilot. Again
One shouldn't confuse the Remote Desktop app with the Remote Desktop Connection application, which has been included in Windows for decades. According to Microsoft, the connection type used by Remote Desktop Connection and Remote Desktop Services is not yet supported by the Windows App.
Currently, users must also have either a school or work account to use the Windows App.
The Windows App supports customizable home screens, multi-monitor setups, and dynamic resolution scaling. There is also device redirection and optimization for Microsoft Teams. Private Link for connecting to Azure Virtual Desktop isn't supported, nor is local Start Menu integration.
Microsoft
warned that the Windows App doesn't work in some environments where proxy servers require proxy/HTTP authentication. Single sign-on (SSO) with Active Directory Federation Services (AD FS) is also not supported.
Customers using the Remote Desktop app must migrate by May 27. After that date, "connections to Windows 365, Azure Virtual Desktop, and Microsoft Dev Box via the Remote Desktop app from the Microsoft Store will be blocked." ®

data.article_summary: 一项由布法罗大学研究人员发表的研究表明，独自听音乐可以提升社交幸福感。该研究发表在《Psychology of Music》期刊上，指出音乐可以作为一种社交替代品，帮助人们减轻孤独感、隔离感以及应对社交威胁（如拒绝）。研究通过两个实验发现，听自己喜欢的音乐能让人感觉不那么孤独，并且在面对社交威胁时，听 favorite 音乐的人比不听的人感受到更多归属感。音乐通过让人与艺术家产生联系、沉浸于音乐世界以及唤起他人记忆等方式发挥作用。这项研究揭示了日常活动如何帮助我们保持健康和快乐。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：背景音乐及噪音对人的心理影响及其相关研究的价值

不同观点：
• JKCalhoun认为外部音乐（通过音箱播放）能帮助避免脑海中反复循环同一首歌，他有一个本地音乐播放列表，并在尝试新音乐后加入合意的曲目。
• riyanapatel享受将熟悉的电视节目作为背景噪音，类似于白噪音的效果，能帮助在工作时集中注意力。
• tananan引用了一种观点，即享受某些事物是主观的，如果缺少某种快乐，用另一种快乐替代可以帮助缓解痛苦。
• singularity2001提出了“现实不匹配”的概念，认为音乐进化上与群体安全感相关，尽管现代社会中群体在时空上已经远离，但通过互联网仍能保持联系。
• jasondigitized分享了一个具体的网络电台作为他的福祉来源。
• hk1337质疑背景电视节目是否与背景音乐有类似的效果，并表示音乐对他来说过于刺激。
• dimal对类似的研究感到厌倦，认为这些研究意义不大，且由于研究结果被付费墙阻挡，无法评估其研究设计和结论的合理性，并对当前部分科学研究感到失望。
• euvitudo观察到他的鸟在音乐播放时显得更快乐，并似乎对某些音乐有偏好。
• pearlsontheroad提出音乐的积极效果可能与对环境自主控制的感觉有关。
• _fat_santa描述了早晨听音乐作为日常routine一部分的重要性。
• ssttoo对标题产生误解，以为讨论的是独奏音乐的特殊效果。
• 6stringmerc强调音乐选择的重要性，并分享了自己在特定环境下被迫听不喜欢的音乐的负面体验，认为这是一种洗脑形式。
• qoez嘲讽那些依赖研究来理解常识的人缺乏独立思考能力。
• chaosprint询问是否有好的应用程序可以了解本地音乐活动。
• Pixelious认为研究结果显而易见，享受任何自己喜欢的事情都能提升幸福感。

补充讨论：
- 背景音乐与背景噪音（如电视节目）在不同情境下的作用和效果。
- 对当前科学研究的质疑与失望，特别是研究的意义和透明度问题。
- 音乐选择自主性的重要性及其对个体体验的影响。
- 背景音乐对动物（如鸟）的行为影响。

Study finds solo music listening boosts social well-being
by Bert Gambini,
University at Buffalo
Credit: Unsplash/CC0 Public Domain
Listening to music by yourself might not seem like a social activity, but University at Buffalo researchers have published a study that suggests how doing so can have valuable social benefits.
"It's a great way to give yourself a social boost and increase your well-being," says Elaine Paravati, Ph.D., the study's corresponding author, who conducted the research while completing her doctorate at UB.
Across two experiments for the study
published
in the journal
Psychology of Music
, Paravati and co-authors—Esha Naidu, Ph.D., a postdoctoral associate at Duke University, who was finishing her graduate work at UB at the time of the research; and Shira Gabriel, Ph.D., a UB professor of psychology—demonstrated how music functions as a social surrogate.
The study's perspective, however, differs from a lot of previous research on the social aspects of music, which often focus on how music brings people together, as listeners and performers.
Paravati instead looked at music enjoyed in isolation.
Humans have a fundamental need to belong, which strongly motivates our behavior. Failing to connect with others can lead to depression, anxiety and low self-esteem. There are traditional ways to fill this need, like spending time with family and friends, but there are non-traditional strategies as well, activities that might not be immediately recognized as social.
These are known as social surrogates, which can buffer against loneliness, isolation and social threats, like rejection, just as well as time spent with others.
Parasocial relationships, such as the one-sided bond between fans and celebrities, immersion into the social world, and reminders of others, are all social surrogates.
"Listening to music alone operates as a social surrogate along all three of those pathways," says Paravati. "All of these paths can help us feel less lonely and more belonging. Music helps us feel connected to the artists; it can make us feel immersed in the world of music; and music can remind us of others.
"You might think you're motivated to listen to your favorite song because you think it has a catchy beat, but it's likely that you're drawn in because that music is filling your social fuel tank and helping you feel a sense of belonging."
For the study's first experiment, researchers asked participants about their use of known social surrogates, such as favorite television shows, as well as their use of music.
"We found that listening to one's favorite music helped individuals feel less lonely," says Paravati. "But someone's favorite music was more effective at this than just listening to music in general.
"In other words, there is something special about putting on your favorite song and jamming out."
For the second experiment, the researchers designed a test to measure the effectiveness of favorite music as a response to a social threat. Participants played a virtual ball-toss game often used for research on social exclusion.
"Again, those who listened to their favorite music felt more belonging than those in the control condition, suggesting that listening to their favorite music buffered against the negative effects of a social threat."
Paravati says future research might explore the impact of
music
genre or the individual differences among the three surrogate pathways and which might be more important than the other two.
"This work is another puzzle piece that shows how
little things
we do in our everyday lives help us to be as healthy and happy as possible," says Paravati.
More information:
Elaine Paravati et al, Thank you for the music: Music as a social surrogate that protects against social threats,
Psychology of Music
(2025).
DOI: 10.1177/03057356241312219

University at Buffalo

data.title: Bored of It
data.author: NotInOurNames
data.article_summary: 这篇文章表达了对某种普遍存在的事物的厌倦和反感，尽管未明确指出具体是什么。作者描述了它的无所不在、不可避免、以及对人性的剥夺。没人真正需要它，但企业、政策制定者和媒体却大力推广它。它需要大量资源来维持，人们不断讨论和使用它，令作者感到厌烦和不适。文章通过一系列反讽和矛盾的描述，传达了对这一现象的深刻厌倦。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：对当前技术（尤其是AI）的看法和态度

不同观点：
• latexr认为，当今被誉为“最优秀的头脑”的人往往只是擅长利用技术谋取利润的贪婪之人，他主张“最优秀的头脑”应具备同情心、哲学思考能力以及耐心和智慧，而不仅仅是在技术上表现突出。
• terhechte引用了道格拉斯·亚当斯的技术反应规则，暗示年龄可能影响对新技术的看法，并调侃猜测latexr的年龄。
• skrebbel指出，过度关注当前技术趋势是一种选择，人们可以选择不让自己被这些趋势包围。
• bufferoverflow反驳“没人需要或想要AI”的观点，认为AI可能是解决衰老、癌症和阿尔茨海默病等复杂问题的唯一机会。
• amelius以幽默的方式建议成立一个新的AI社区。
• petercooper认为每个技术进步都会引发某种程度的“新卢德主义”情绪，并建议如果当前群体希望实现变革，可能需要一个像Ned Ludd这样的代表人物。
• gatinsama表示完全不觉得无聊，认为讨论AI的用途、误用和影响是值得的，即使有些方面令人疲劳。
• egeozcan分享了WhatsApp集成AI功能引发的情感，认为这反映了文章中对AI的感受。
• teekert讲述了自己学习编写单元测试的经历，表示对AI话题不感到无聊，并认为技术讨论可以应用于多种领域。
• clovoak反驳“没人需要或想要AI”的说法，指出许多用户已经从AI中受益。
• martindbp分析了人们对AI的两种反应：工程师或工匠感到威胁，而那些喜欢创造或解决问题的人则欢迎AI。
• DontchaKnowit认为AI是无聊的谈话主题，表示会直接忽略相关讨论。
• thih9质疑“它”是否一定指AI，认为这种讨论可能适用于任何新技术，如iPhone，并指出这种循环过程的无聊性。
• viraptor以幽默方式回应，认为文章中的长篇铺垫只是为了一个糟糕的玩笑。
• freetime2反驳“输入垃圾，输出垃圾”的观点，认为AI的输出质量已经非常高，并认为AI技术将会继续发展并留存。

补充讨论：
• 对AI的看法存在明显分歧，一些人认为AI是解决问题的关键工具，另一些人则感到无聊或反感。
• 讨论中多次提到技术疲劳和对新技术的接受度，涉及年龄、个人选择和职业身份对技术态度的影响。
• AI的应用和影响是讨论的核心，包括伦理、实用性和对社会的潜在贡献。

43580449.article_content:
I’m bored of it.
The pervasive, all encompassing nature of it.
The inevitable, dehumanising consequence of it.
That there’s a ‘there’ there to it.
Rubbish in and rubbish out of it.
Nobody asked for it, and nobody wants it.
The best minds of my generation thinking about how to make people use it.
That you should just accept it.
A thousand no’s, but ‘yes’ when shareholders start clamouring for it.
Policy-makers pandering to it.
A decommissioned nuclear power station required to power it.
Not to mention millions of gallons of water required to cool it.
Every article glorifying it.
Every article vilifying it.
Every pub conversation winding up talking about it.
People incessantly telling you how
they
use it.
I feel dirty using it.
You know what I’m talking about, even though I’ve not mentioned it.
And that’s why I’m bored of it.

data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：Google Drive下载问题及编程项目的复杂性

不同观点：
• [netsharc] 认为Google Drive在下载大文件时存在问题，尤其是当尝试下载整个目录时，系统只打包部分文件且没有明显提示。他对此表示不满，认为Google在这方面的处理很糟糕。

• [cjs_ac] 则将讨论引向编程项目中的复杂性问题，引用Rob Pike的观点，强调在小规模项目中不应使用过于复杂的算法和结构。他还批评了在简单项目中加入不必要步骤的教程设计，认为这会增加不必要的复杂性。

补充讨论：
• [probably_wrong] 提供了一个背景链接，可能是为了让不了解2012年相关背景的用户更好地理解讨论内容。

• [redm] 表示对原帖或者相关内容感到幽默，认为随着时间推移，这种情况变得更加有趣。

• [jonatron] 提到文本转语音技术自那时以来已经有了很大改进，将讨论引向技术进步的话题。

争议焦点：
• [netsharc] 对Google Drive下载问题的实际体验与Google的技术能力之间的矛盾，反映出用户在使用云服务时的实际困难与期望不符。
• [cjs_ac] 对编程项目复杂性的看法，特别是对"Hello World"程序是否应包含复杂步骤的不同见解，反映出开发者在项目初始阶段对简化与复杂性之间的权衡。

• [netsharc] 认为Google Drive在下载大文件时存在问题，尤其是当尝试下载整个目录时，系统只打包部分文件且没有明显提示。他对此表示不满，认为Google在这方面的处理很糟糕。

• [cjs_ac] 则将讨论引向编程项目中的复杂性问题，引用Rob Pike的观点，强调在小规模项目中不应使用过于复杂的算法和结构。他还批评了在简单项目中加入不必要步骤的教程设计，认为这会增加不必要的复杂性。

补充讨论：
• [probably_wrong] 提供了一个背景链接，可能是为了让不了解2012年相关背景的用户更好地理解讨论内容。

• [redm] 表示对原帖或者相关内容感到幽默，认为随着时间推移，这种情况变得更加有趣。

• [jonatron] 提到文本转语音技术自那时以来已经有了很大改进，将讨论引向技术进步的话题。

• [cjs_ac] 对编程项目复杂性的看法，特别是对"Hello World"程序是否应包含复杂步骤的不同见解，反映出开发者在项目初始阶段对简化与复杂性之间的权衡。

不同观点：
• 一些用户对项目的规模和AI工具的结合持积极态度。Multiplayer认为该项目的代码库对AI工具的改进有潜在帮助，并提到悬赏机制虽然奖金不多，但仍具激励作用。

data.title: On JavaScript's Weirdness
data.author: n2d4
data.article_summary:
本文讨论了JavaScript中一些鲜为人知的怪异行为，超越了常见的`'0' == 0`这类问题。作者指出了三个更隐蔽的怪癖：

1. **`eval`的特殊行为**：`eval`函数在直接调用时可以访问当前作用域，而重命名的`eval`只能访问全局作用域。这是因为ECMAScript规范对`eval`调用有特殊处理，增加了引擎的复杂性。

2. **循环变量捕获问题**：JavaScript的循环变量默认按引用捕获。在`for`循环中使用`let`定义变量时，JavaScript会进行特殊处理，使得每次循环的变量像是按值捕获，但如果在循环外定义变量则会出现不同的行为。

3. **虚假对象**：通常认为JavaScript有8个虚假值，但实际上还有一个被忽视的对象——`document.all`，它表现为虚假值但又是对象。

这些 quirks 虽然不常被提及，但在特定情况下会影响代码行为，值得开发者注意。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：JavaScript（及TypeScript）中的语言特性、怪异行为及其在现代开发中的相关性

不同观点：
• pcthrowaway认为文章中对块作用域与词法作用域以及事件循环中的执行顺序存在误解。他通过示例说明`let`和`var`在循环中的不同表现，并提出解决方法（如使用IIFE）来处理变量作用域问题。
• brap引用《The Good Parts》一书，认为JavaScript确实存在一些不优雅的部分，但可以通过严格的linter和选择性忽略这些部分来使语言更加稳固和优雅。
• glenjamin对for循环行为的抱怨感到奇怪，认为当前的变量作用域设计合理，并提到Go语言也曾经历类似的语义变化。
• Leszek指出`eval`的性能成本问题，强调它对于性能优化的重要性，因为它允许解析器静态地判断变量是否可以被优化掉。
• rs186认为关于JavaScript怪异行为的讨论大多涉及过时的实践，现代开发中使用ES6+和TypeScript已经解决了这些问题，且这些怪异行为很少在生产代码中出现。
• smjburton质疑这些语言怪异行为在现代JavaScript开发中的相关性，尤其是在使用框架（如React、Vue）的情况下，这些"陷阱"在实践中并不常见。
• nobleach认为这些"怪异行为"是实际可能遇到的"陷阱"，相比"Wat视频"中的极端例子更加现实。
• vanderZwan指出+0 vs. -0的怪异行为属于浮点数特性，而非JavaScript独有问题，除非使用Math.sign或除以负零，否则对实际代码无影响。
• 0xbadcafebee对'0' == 0这种宽松比较持宽容态度，尤其是在脚本任务中，但认为不应在核心业务产品开发中使用类似Shellscript的语言。
• theThree提到TypeScript中函数参数类型不匹配导致的错误，认为这是基础知识，但可能被重复讨论。
• larrik不理解对'0' == 0的抱怨，指出HTTP和SQL中也有类似行为，并认为JavaScript和其生态系统中有更多令人烦恼的问题。
• Klaster_1认为这些怪异行为是JavaScript学习者已知的"坏部分"，重复这些基础知识无必要，文章有可能是博客垃圾重述。
• blatantly认为一些怪异行为（如for循环捕获行为、缺少分号、稀疏数组等）是可以通过linter或文档学习来避免的。
• skrebbel对`document.all`性能慢于`getElementById`感到困惑，希望了解编译器为何不直接将前者优化为后者。

补充讨论：
• 关于JavaScript怪异行为在现代开发中的实际影响存在争议，部分人认为这些陷阱在生产代码中很少遇到，尤其是在使用TypeScript和现代框架的情况下。
• 对`eval`和`document.all`等特定语言特性的性能和设计选择存在不同解释和疑惑。

主要讨论点：针对数据泄露和金融诈骗事件的应对措施及责任归属

不同观点：
• IronCoder1 强调了强化安全措施的重要性，特别是对敏感财务数据而言。他认为养老基金必须优先投资于先进的网络安全防御和事件响应计划，且透明的沟通对于维护信任和减轻潜在损害至关重要。

• trollbridge 分享了他们防止发票诈骗的详细措施，包括使用专门的银行账户接受存款并立即转移资金，严格的支付信息变更程序，以及对客户的警示和建议。他们声称至今没有因诈骗损失任何资金，显示出其措施的有效性。

• seb1240 对养老金损失表示不满，认为应该是养老基金因为安全 breach 而遭受损失，而不是个人。他将此与银行被抢劫类比，认为个人不应承担责任。

• taberiand 认为，基于600个账户平均损失800美元的情况，以及假设用户密码安全不佳，事件的损失并不严重。他还指出快速检测和立即锁定的反应是有效和良好的。

• dbetteridge 批评了其超级基金在多因素认证（MFA）选项上仅提供短信或电子邮件的方式，暗示这种安全性不足可能是导致安全事件的原因。

• oldandboring 提供了一个存档链接，可能指向相关事件的进一步信息或讨论。

• damhsa 将此次损失与工资盗窃、通货膨胀、租金、利息等资本扩张形式进行了对比，引用《共产党宣言》暗示这些损失在更广泛的社会经济背景下并不显著。

补充讨论：
• 争议的焦点之一是责任归属问题，seb1240 认为个人不应为养老基金的安全 breach 承担损失。
• 另一个讨论点是安全措施的有效性，trollbridge 详细描述了其公司防止诈骗的措施，显示出实践中的成功案例。
• 对事件响应的评价也有分歧，IronCoder1 强调了透明沟通和快速行动的重要性，而 taberiand 则认为基于事件的规模，现有的应对已经足够有效。
• dbetteridge 对认证方式的批评指向了技术实现上的安全漏洞，提示了安全措施中的潜在缺陷。
• damhsa 从更广泛的社会经济学视角看待此次事件的损失，将其与更大范围的经济现象进行对比。

data.title: The psychology behind why children are hooked on Minecraft
data.author: andsoitis
data.article_summary: 《Minecraft》之所以吸引孩子，源于人类深层的心理和进化因素，尤其是对建造事物的内在渴望。游戏让孩子们在虚拟世界中自由创造，类似于他们用沙子、积木或乐高进行的建造游戏。心理学家Peter Gray指出，这种建造游戏反映了人类通过建造获得生存优势的进化本能，孩子们通过玩耍准备成年所需技能。此外，Minecraft提供了无特定目标的创造空间，满足了孩子在电脑上实现创意的冲动，而这种冲动在传统计算机操作中可能受到限制。尽管一些家长担心孩子沉迷于游戏，但专家认为这种玩耍反映了现代孩子对科技和创造力的自然适应。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：Minecraft受欢迎的原因以及其玩法和体验的多样性

不同观点：
• OgsyedIE认为Minecraft的开放性玩法允许孩子们自行设定目标并锻炼时间管理能力，游戏中的成就和奖杯并不是核心驱动力，而是提供了让孩子发挥创造力的机会。
• Chiffre01通过个人经历说明，类似于Minecraft的自由探索体验（例如Kings Quest II）能够带来纯粹的快乐，这种自由度是吸引孩子的关键因素。
• Astrobe_引用Bartle的玩家类型分类法，指出Minecraft的社交元素、战斗、探索、创造和生存玩法满足了不同类型玩家的需求，解释了游戏的广泛吸引力。
• Autoexec不理解为什么孩子会花时间看Minecraft视频，虽然承认积木类玩具一直很受欢迎，但对视频观看行为表示困惑。
• Move-on-by分享了个人经验，通过设置不同规则的服务器与家人一起玩Minecraft，强调了游戏作为家庭 bonding 体验的作用，并指出游戏不仅限于屏幕时间，还能影响现实活动。

补充讨论：
• 5bolts认为Minecraft更像是一种玩具而非传统游戏，玩家可以随意选择玩法，从简单的休闲活动到复杂的社区模组探索，游戏具有高度的自由度和多样性。
• Hoseja和Banqjls的评论带有幽默性质，Hoseja暗示现代社会中户外活动的减少可能促使了Minecraft的流行，Banqjls的评论则是对Minecraft中"采矿"元素的调侃。
• Andsoitis的评论简短，强调了“建造的欲望”作为Minecraft吸引力的核心。

争议焦点：
• Minecraft作为一种玩具还是一种游戏的定位存在一定的讨论，5bolts更倾向于将其视为一种具有无限可能的玩具，而autoexec则对这种自由度与视频观看行为的关联表示不解。
• 不同玩家对Minecraft的体验和玩法有着多样化的理解，从自由探索到社交互动，再到家庭 bonding 和现实影响，这些不同的视角展示了游戏广泛的吸引力。

43554123.article_content:
The psychology behind why children are hooked on Minecraft
4 days ago
Share
Save
Chris Baraniuk
Share
Save
Alamy
Minecraft is the world's best-selling computer game and soon to be a Hollywood film. This is why children can't get enough of it.
AJ Minotti has three children – and they all love playing Minecraft. His twin girls aged 10 and his six-year-old son are constantly building stuff with the endless supply of virtual blocks that fill the game. And Minotti, who works in marketing in Ohio, sometimes gets blown away with what they come up with.
"Dad, I want to show you something," one of his daughters said to him recently as she held out the screen of her Nintendo Switch. Her avatar stood before a waterfall. After pressing an in-game button, the waterfall stopped, revealing the entrance to a cave. Inside was a subterranean super-lair complete with interactive lighting and display areas for items that she had collected in the game.
"It was like this whole underground mansion, basically," says Minotti, marvelling. "I was super impressed by it." His daughter had followed some YouTube tutorials but also came up with much of the design herself. "It takes me back to the feelings I had when I was a kid just hacking away on a computer," says Minotti.
Minecraft is one of the most popular video games of all time. First released in 2009, it had sold
more than 300 million copies
by 2023. It, and similar games including Roblox and Terraria, are enjoyed by gamers of all ages, from young children to adults.
The game seems able absorb the attention of children for up to
hours at a time
– no mean feat in our distraction-filled age. Some parents fear their
children's interest in Minecraft can border on obsession
, or even addiction, as they struggle to tear them away from the computer screen.
Minecraft's popularity is such that it has now spawned a highly anticipated Hollywood film called A Minecraft Movie, starring Jack Black and Jason Momoa, which is due to
be released in April 2025
.
There could be deep psychological – even evolutionary – factors behind the success of Minecraft and games like it, say experts. Such games tap into an innate instinct within all of us – one that underpins the success of our entire species. The desire to build.
Warner Bros
Minecraft has now been turned into a hotly anticipated, star-studded Hollywood film (Credit: Warner Bros)
If you think about it, children have always enjoyed making things – sandcastles, forts, treehouses – to name a few. Consider also wooden blocks, playdough and Lego pieces. Minecraft is, arguably, just a recent iteration of this kind of play, but in a digital space. But why is building things so irresistible for many children in the first place?
All mammals play when they're young, says Peter Gray, a psychologist who studies children's ways of learning at Boston College, in Massachusetts, US. Predatory animals, for example, play at catching things. Prey animals practise dodging and darting.
"They play at the skills that are most important for them to develop for their survival and ultimate ability to mate," says Gray. Humans are unlike other animals in that we owe much of our survival to our ability to build stuff – from mud huts
to tools for hunting
and gathering. "It's not surprising that natural selection endowed young people with a strong drive to
play at building things
," says Gray.
He notes that children also play using language and imagination, or make games that have rules and social interaction at their heart – all seemingly as part of preparation for adulthood.
What youngsters choose to build during playtime, and how they build it, tends to reflect the culture they live in, says Gray. "We should not be at all surprised that kids are really drawn to playing on computers today – nor should that distress us," he says. "Kids know in their bones, in their instincts I would say, that these are the skills [they] need to develop."
Minecraft players tend to differ from the population at large, being substantially more curious and less driven by traits such as vengeance
Julian Togelius, a computer scientist at New York University, has noticed the impulse to build things emerging in his son – who is not even three years old. At nursery, he immediately starts making tunnels so that he can drive toy trains and trucks through them, explains Togelius. When his son gets a bit older, computers might become irresistible. Crucially, sandbox games ­– video games such as Minecraft that offer players the freedom to explore their creativity without any particular goal – make it easy to interact with and do things on computers, says Togelius.
"In Minecraft world, creating [something] is direct and simple," he explains. "It's way easier than writing code." In other words, games like this satisfy the innate urge to build when computers, traditionally, might otherwise hinder that impulse, especially for children.

data.title: Doge staffer's YouTube nickname accidentally revealed his teen hacking activity
data.author: rbanffy
data.article_summary:
Christopher Stanley，一名由埃隆·马斯克的政府效率部门（DOGE）派往美国司法部（DOJ）的SpaceX和X工程师，被曝曾夸耀从事黑客活动，包括分发盗版电子书、盗版软件和游戏作弊工具。这些夸耀出现在一些网站的存档中，被举报后迅速删除。尽管马斯克声称DOGE运作透明，但其员工身份和政府角色鲜为人知。斯坦利在DOJ的具体职责不明，但其涉及的办公室负责调查包括黑客在内的网络犯罪活动。

斯坦利的可疑过去可追溯到2006年，当时他还在高中。他使用多个网名，如Reneg4d3，在不同网站和论坛上活跃。15岁时，他创建了一个包含不当内容的网站，并夸耀攻击服务器。16岁时，他通过漏洞获取管理权限，并贬低其他论坛。他还涉及创建多个黑客论坛，尽管曾因黑客活动被网络服务提供商暂停服务，但并未停止相关活动。

2010年，斯坦利声称因收到法律威胁不再从事黑客活动，但2014年又参与Lizard Squad的黑客活动。专家认为，斯坦利的黑客背景是一个危险信号，特别是如果他在处理敏感信息时。DOGE员工的身份问题也引发了更多关注和调查要求。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：对青少年时期黑客行为的看法及隐私问题

不同观点：
• **怀旧与隐私保护的庆幸**：KillenBoek和INTPenis等人表示，庆幸自己年轻时的行为没有被互联网记录下来，能够保护个人隐私。他们认为，过去在互联网不发达的时代成长是一种幸运，因为那些愚蠢的行为不会被永久记录和公开。
• **现代匿名的便利与误解**：firefax认为，现代技术让匿名更加容易，但年轻人可能误将这种技术便利视为技能的体现，从而导致错误判断。他指出，现代的匿名手段（如星巴克热点、一次性手机卡）让隐藏身份变得简单，但并不代表技术能力提升。

A SpaceX and X engineer, Christopher Stanley—currently serving as a senior advisor in the Deputy Attorney General's office at the Department of Justice (DOJ)—was reportedly caught bragging about hacking and distributing pirated e-books, bootleg software, and game cheats.
The boasts appeared on archived versions of websites, of which several, once flagged, were quickly deleted, Reuters
reported
.
Stanley was assigned to the DOJ by Elon Musk's Department of Government Efficiency (DOGE). While Musk claims that DOGE operates transparently, not much is known about who the staffers are or what their government roles entail. It remains unclear what Stanley does at DOJ, but Reuters noted that the Deputy Attorney General’s office is in charge of investigations into various crimes, "including hacking and other malicious cyber activity." Declining to comment further, the DOJ did confirm that as a "special government employee," like Musk, Stanley does not draw a government salary.
The engineer's questionable past seemingly dates back to 2006, Reuters reported, when Stanley was still in high school. The news site connected Stanley to various sites and forums by tracing various pseudonyms he still uses, including Reneg4d3, a nickname he still uses on YouTube. The outlet then further verified the connection "by cross-referencing the sites’ registration data against his old email address and by matching Reneg4d3’s biographical data to Stanley’s."
Among his earliest sites was one featuring a "crude sketch of a penis" called fkn-pwnd.com, where Stanley, at 15, bragged about "fucking up servers," a now-deleted Internet Archive screenshot reportedly showed. Another, reneg4d3.com, was launched when he was 16. There, Stanley branded a competing messaging board "stupid noobs" after supposedly gaining admin access through an "easy exploit," Reuters reported. On Bluesky, an account called "doge whisperer"
alleges
even more hacking activity, some of which appears to be corroborated by an IA
screenshot
of another site Stanley created, electonic.net (sic), which as of this writing can still be accessed.
At this time, Stanley seemed unafraid of consequences. His Internet service provider once suspended him for targeting a rival game-cheating site, Reuters reported. He'd supposedly hijacked and defaced the site with a message that confirmed, "This site has been hacked by RENEG4D3.com," according to a screenshot of the rival site preserved by DomainTools. But that suspension didn't stop him from creating other hacker forums on sites like error33.net, IA's now-deleted archive reportedly showed, and electonic.net.
However, around the age of 19, Stanley appeared to understand that publicly bragging about hacking might not be the best idea. After supposedly receiving a legal threat from a South Korean gaming company Nexon Co, he claimed in a 2010 post that "I no longer hack into Paypals, gain root access into other peoples computer (sic), or exploit online websites," Reuters reported. (Nexon told Reuters it could find no information on the alleged legal threat.)
SpaceX and X so far have not commented on the report. Hours after Reuters reached out to Stanley—who did not respond to a request for comment—"several of his old websites vanished from the Internet Archive," Reuters reported. IA confirmed that "people who own the rights to sites can request to have their content withheld from the archive," but declined to answer specific questions about the removals.
Experts see hacker past as red flag
Six former DOJ officials told Reuters that Stanley's background as a hacker "raised red flags," particularly if he's handling sensitive information that, if exposed, could reveal how federal probes are conducted or violate grand jury secrecy rules.
Among them was Jonathan Rusch, a 25-year DOJ veteran prosecutor now in academia, who told Reuters that Stanley's apparent history of disclosing illegally acquired data should have prompted "serious concerns." A background check may also have flagged that after Stanley claimed to be done with hacking,  he, in 2014, "posted footage of himself carrying out a hack" for a hacking group called Lizard Squad. That year, Lizard Squad
took credit for attacks against Sony's PlayStation Network
, Reuters noted.
Stanley's past isn't the only one raising eyebrows across government, as DOGE workers' identities are slowly learned, commonly revealed through court filings and media reports.
One of the earliest known DOGE staffers, Marko Elez, resigned after racist social media posts from his past were surfaced, The Wall Street Journal
reported
. And last week, Democrats in the Republican-controlled House of Representatives Oversight Committee demanded a "full investigation into WHO is working for DOGE" after Reuters
reported
that records apparently linked another DOGE staffer, Edward Cor
43579925.article_summary:
Christopher Stanley，一名由埃隆·马斯克的政府效率部门（DOGE）派往美国司法部（DOJ）的SpaceX和X工程师，被曝曾夸耀从事黑客活动，包括分发盗版电子书、盗版软件和游戏作弊工具。这些夸耀出现在一些网站的存档中，被举报后迅速删除。尽管马斯克声称DOGE运作透明，但其员工身份和政府角色鲜为人知。斯坦利在DOJ的具体职责不明，但其涉及的办公室负责调查包括黑客在内的网络犯罪活动。

斯坦利的可疑过去可追溯到2006年，当时他还在高中。他使用多个网名，如Reneg4d3，在不同网站和论坛上活跃。15岁时，他创建了一个包含不当内容的网站，并夸耀攻击服务器。16岁时，他通过漏洞获取管理权限，并贬低其他论坛。他还涉及创建多个黑客论坛，尽管曾因黑客活动被网络服务提供商暂停服务，但并未停止相关活动。

2010年，斯坦利声称因收到法律威胁不再从事黑客活动，但2014年又参与Lizard Squad的黑客活动。专家认为，斯坦利的黑客背景是一个危险信号，特别是如果他在处理敏感信息时。DOGE员工的身份问题也引发了更多关注和调查要求。

How Silica Gel Took Over the World
Spencer Wright
I find them stuffed into the toes of a new pair of sneakers. I find them wedged into a sheaf of seaweed snacks. I find them in the over-inflated bag that contains my new inhaler, and in the vacuum-sealed one puckered around my kids’ 3D printing filament. “DO NOT EAT,” they all admonish me, and I find myself slipping them under the top layer of the garbage already in the trash can, as if my kids wouldn’t be able to control their urge to taste whatever is inside these tiny white pouches. Silica gel packets are
everywhere
, their presence seemingly the only thing keeping our packaged food crispy and our belongings free of mildew. How on earth did they all get here?
Is silica gel taking over the world?
Tear its little Tyvek wrapping, and spill a packet of glassy silica gel beads into the palm of your hand; they won’t hurt you. They are made of the same stuff as sand: “Silica” means “silicon dioxide,” which is the primary component of most drinkware, windshields, and the screen of whatever electronic device you’re reading this on. But glass has a density of around 2500 kilograms per cubic meter, and crystalline silicon dioxide (quartz) is around 2650. Silica gel, on the other hand, is more like 700 kilograms per cubic meter. It may look fully dense, but in fact it’s shot through with countless tiny pores. If your windowpane is like a thin sheet of solid ice, then a silica gel bead is like a tiny snowball.
Silica gel beads, as seen by a scanning electron microscope. Image credit: Dusan Berek, via
Structural inhomogeneities in wide-pore silica gels
.
Zoom in on a silica gel bead with a scanning electron microscope, and its smooth surface turns discontinuous, riddled with voids about 2.5 nanometers across (roughly the diameter of a strand of DNA). This microstructure gives silica gel radical properties. The silica gel packets in my kids’ seaweed snacks are just a little bit bigger than postage stamps, and have a total mass of about a gram. That single gram of silica gel could have an internal surface area of eight hundred square meters—the size of
almost two basketball courts
.
These factors allow silica gel to adsorb up to 40% of its own weight in water vapor, through a process called
capillary condensation
. When humid air migrates into the pores of a silica gel bead, its vapor pressure increases, causing water to condense onto the silica gel’s internal surfaces. At the risk of anthropomorphizing water, it’s as if it prefers to be a liquid, stuck within the silica gel’s tiny capillaries, than a vapor, carried along with whatever else is in the air.
If you find a packet of silica gel in an imported snack or the pocket of a new jacket, it’s probably there to filter water vapor out of air. Like most filters, there is a limit to how much water a piece of silica gel can hold; its internal surfaces are finite in size, and as a result there is a finite amount of humidity that a given packet of silica gel can adsorb. Luckily, silica gel vendors offer nifty calculators so that their customers can size their silica gel packets to the volumes of air they wish to dry out—and how dry they want the air to be. If you wanted to desiccate the air inside of a child’s balloon, you’d calculate its volume (let’s call it 14 liters), then make some assumptions about its temperature and humidity (around 35°C, 75% RH), then decide what you want its final relative humidity to be (let’s bring it down to 20% RH). Run these numbers and you’d find you needed to pull about 0.3 grams of water out of the air in your balloon. This can be done, pretty reliably, with a one- or two-gram packet of silica gel, slipped into the balloon just before you blow it up.
Of course, different applications will entail different goals. The bag that holds your potato chips is not
completely
impermeable to moisture, and if you’re going to ship it across an ocean and then let it sit on a shelf for a few months, you should expect some additional water vapor to find its way in. There are also applications in which silica gel is used not so much to dry something out but to maintain a particular equilibrium humidity. In the art world, silica gel packets are slipped into exhibit cases and
used for their “buffering capacity,”
helping maintain a stable (and relatively high) humidity inside the case while conditions in the rest of the gallery might vary.
Silica gel is commonly placed inside museum display cases, in hidden compartments that ventilate to the display chamber. Image via the National Park Service's *very* thorough
Exhibit Conservation Guidelines, Second Edition
.
While glass and glassy substances have been used by humans for many thousands of years, it wasn’t until the early twentieth century that Walter Patrick, a researcher at Johns Hopkins, developed
and patented
an efficient way to create silica gel. He did this by mixing a substance called “water glass” with an acid.

data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：贸易逆差及其经济影响，以及如何应对贸易不平衡

不同观点：
• [forgotoldacc] 认为，像英国和美国这样的国家通过进口低价值产品并专注于高价值 goods 和服务的生产来维持经济优势。他质疑是否应该通过转向生产低价值产品来平衡贸易逆差，并指出这种策略对长期经济发展未必有利。
• [iNic] 认为，虽然有人曾担心贸易逆差的影响，但历史数据显示这种趋势并没有导致明显的负面经济变化，因此无需过于担忧。
• [borlox] 指出，美国从其高科技产品和服务（如Windows、Netflix、iPhone等）中获得了巨大收益，并质疑如果其他国家停止购买这些产品和服务，是否会对美国有利。
• [randyrand] 提到，iPhone等产品的价值主要由美国获取，但整个出口额却被算作中国的，这反映了当前贸易统计方法的不合理性。
• [kryptiskt] 认为，贸易逆差并非零和游戏，德国和瑞典通过压低国内消费来保持贸易顺差，但这对整体经济未必有益。他主张通过增加消费来促进经济发展。
• [CMCDragonkai] 建议，非美国国家应对美国的互联网服务实施关税，以应对商品与服务之间的贸易失衡。
• [supermatt] 认为，解决贸易逆差的方法是生产其他国家想要购买的产品，而不是通过惩罚性措施来实现平衡。
• [gargan] 指出，商界人士未必是最好的经济学家或政治家，暗示在经济政策上需要更多的专业见解。
• [yonran] 引用了Squanderville和Thriftville的寓言，并讨论了土地垄断和私人土地所有权对贸易逆差的影响，提出土地价值税可能是一个解决方案。
• [thefounder] 担心，如果美国减少消费并转向自制产品，可能会导致市场效率降低，并对经济产生不利影响。
• [ucha] 认为，随着增长和通胀，外国拥有美国资产的比例可能并不像看上去那么严重，并解释了新财富创造和通胀对外国资产持有比例的影响。
• [dachworker] 通过对比德国和日本的经济，指出制造业和高价值产品生产未必能带来持续的经济增长和创新，认为美国应寻找其他经济增长点。

补充讨论：
• 争议的焦点在于贸易逆差的统计和其对经济的影响，特别是如何平衡贸易逆差以及是否需要通过改变生产结构来实现这一目标。
• 讨论中多次提到美国在高科技和服务业方面的优势，并质疑这些优势在贸易逆差统计中的体现是否合理。
• 有人提出通过增加消费来促进经济发展，而不是单纯依靠制造业或压低消费来保持贸易顺差。
• 最后，历史数据和不同国家的经济模式被用作论据，以支持对贸易逆差的不同看法和应对策略。

• [CMCDragonkai] 建议，非美国国家应对美国的互联网服务实施关税，以应对商品与服务之间的贸易失衡。
• [supermatt] 认为，解决贸易逆差的方法是生产其他国家想要购买的产品，而不是通过惩罚性措施来实现平衡。
• [gargan] 指出，商界人士未必是最好的经济学家或政治家，暗示在经济政策上需要更多的专业见解。
• [yonran] 引用了Squanderville和Thriftville的寓言，并讨论了土地垄断和私人土地所有权对贸易逆差的影响，提出土地价值税可能是一个解决方案。
• [thefounder] 担心，如果美国减少消费并转向自制产品，可能会导致市场效率降低，并对经济产生不利影响。
• [ucha] 认为，随着增长和通胀，外国拥有美国资产的比例可能并不像看上去那么严重，并解释了新财富创造和通胀对外国资产持有比例的影响。
• [dachworker] 通过对比德国和日本的经济，指出制造业和高价值产品生产未必能带来持续的经济增长和创新，认为美国应寻找其他经济增长点。

补充讨论：
• 争议的焦点在于贸易逆差的统计和其对经济的影响，特别是如何平衡贸易逆差以及是否需要通过改变生产结构来实现这一目标。
• 讨论中多次提到美国在高科技和服务业方面的优势，并质疑这些优势在贸易逆差统计中的体现是否合理。
• 有人提出通过增加消费来促进经济发展，而不是单纯依靠制造业或压低消费来保持贸易顺差。
• 最后，历史数据和不同国家的经济模式被用作论据，以支持对贸易逆差的不同看法和应对策略。

• 争议的焦点在于关税政策的实际效果和长期影响。支持者看重其短期保护作用，质疑者担心其可能引发的反制和经济不稳定。

data.author: tim_sw
data.article_summary: 本文探讨了如何通过推理时扩展计算资源来改进大型语言模型（LLM）的奖励建模（RM），提出了**推理时可扩展的通用奖励建模**方法。作者采用逐点生成奖励模型（GRM）以适应不同输入类型，并提出自原理批评调优（SPCT）方法，通过在线强化学习提高GRM的可扩展性和奖励生成效果，构建了**DeepSeek-GRM**模型。实验表明，SPCT显著提升了GRM的质量和可扩展性，在多种RM基准上优于现有方法，且优于训练时扩展。模型将开源。

Title:
Inference-Time Scaling for Generalist Reward Modeling
Authors:

View a PDF of the paper titled Inference-Time Scaling for Generalist Reward Modeling, by Zijun Liu and 7 other authors
View PDF
Abstract:
Reinforcement learning (RL) has been widely adopted in post-training for large language models (LLMs) at scale. Recently, the incentivization of reasoning capabilities in LLMs from RL indicates that $\textit{proper learning methods could enable effective inference-time scalability}$. A key challenge of RL is to obtain accurate reward signals for LLMs in various domains beyond verifiable questions or artificial rules. In this work, we investigate how to improve reward modeling (RM) with more inference compute for general queries, i.e. the $\textbf{inference-time scalability of generalist RM}$, and further, how to improve the effectiveness of performance-compute scaling with proper learning methods. For the RM approach, we adopt pointwise generative reward modeling (GRM) to enable flexibility for different input types and potential for inference-time scaling. For the learning method, we propose Self-Principled Critique Tuning (SPCT) to foster scalable reward generation behaviors in GRMs through online RL, to generate principles adaptively and critiques accurately, resulting in $\textbf{DeepSeek-GRM}$ models. Furthermore, for effective inference-time scaling, we use parallel sampling to expand compute usage, and introduce a meta RM to guide voting process for better scaling performance. Empirically, we show that SPCT significantly improves the quality and scalability of GRMs, outperforming existing methods and models in various RM benchmarks without severe biases, and could achieve better performance compared to training-time scaling. DeepSeek-GRM still meets challenges in some tasks, which we believe can be addressed by future efforts in generalist reward systems. The models will be released and open-sourced.

data.title: China announces zero-tariff treatment for least developed countries
data.author: DeathArrow
data.article_summary:
中国宣布对最不发达国家实施零关税待遇

2024年9月12日，中国国务院关税税则委员会发表声明，中国将对所有与中国有外交关系的最不发达国家在100%的关税条目上给予零关税待遇。该政策将于今年12月1日起实施，旨在扩大对最不发达国家的单方面开放，实现共同发展。对于实行关税配额管理的商品，配额内的产品将享受零关税，而超配额部分的关税则保持不变。该举措旨在促进国际合作与发展。

来源：www.gov.cn
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：对2024年的展望和评价

不同观点：
• 观点一：对2024年持乐观态度  
  Galichev认为2024年将带来积极的变化和机会。他提到科技进步和全球经济的复苏将为社会带来诸多好处。他特别指出人工智能和可再生能源领域的突破可能会显著改善人们的生活质量。

• 观点二：对2024年持谨慎态度  
  有些评论者对2024年持谨慎乐观的态度。他们承认科技和经济的潜在进步，但担心这些变化可能会带来社会不平等的加剧。他们指出，如果政策不当，技术进步可能只会让少数人受益，而大部分人会被抛在后面。

• 观点三：对2024年持悲观态度  
  另一部分评论者对2024年表示担忧。他们认为全球政治局势的不稳定和环境问题将对社会造成严重影响。他们特别提到气候变化可能会导致更多的自然灾害，而国际关系的紧张可能会引发地区冲突。

• 观点四：中立且观望态度  
  还有一部分人持中立态度，认为2024年既有积极的一面，也有消极的一面。他们对未来保持观望，认为具体发展将取决于多方面的因素，如政策执行、国际合作和科技创新等。

补充讨论：
• 争议的焦点在于科技进步和经济增长是否能够惠及大多数人。持乐观态度的人认为技术进步和经济复苏会带来广泛的社会效益，而持悲观态度的人则担心这些进步可能会加剧社会不平等。
• 有评论者提出，应该更加关注政策制定和社会保障体系的完善，以确保科技和经济进步的成果能够被更广泛地分享。
• 环保和气候变化问题也是讨论中的重要议题，一些人认为，如果不能有效应对气候变化，其他方面的进步可能都会被环境问题所抵消。

以上是对评论的分析和总结，涵盖了主要观点和讨论要点。

China announces zero-tariff treatment for least developed countries
Updated: September 12, 2024 20:15
Xinhua
BEIJING, Sept. 12 -- China will give all the least developed countries having diplomatic relations with China zero-tariff treatment for 100 percent tariff lines, according to a statement from the Customs Tariff Commission of the State Council published on Thursday.
The treatment, effective from Dec. 1 of this year, aims to expand unilateral opening to the least developed countries and achieve common development, the statement said.
For products subject to tariff quota administration, goods within the quota will enjoy zero tariffs, while tariff rates on goods exceeding the quota will remain unchanged, it said.

2024年9月12日，中国国务院关税税则委员会发表声明，中国将对所有与中国有外交关系的最不发达国家在100%的关税条目上给予零关税待遇。该政策将于今年12月1日起实施，旨在扩大对最不发达国家的单方面开放，实现共同发展。对于实行关税配额管理的商品，配额内的产品将享受零关税，而超配额部分的关税则保持不变。该举措旨在促进国际合作与发展。

来源：www.gov.cn

不同观点：
• 观点一：对2024年持乐观态度  
  Galichev认为2024年将带来积极的变化和机会。他提到科技进步和全球经济的复苏将为社会带来诸多好处。他特别指出人工智能和可再生能源领域的突破可能会显著改善人们的生活质量。

• 观点二：对2024年持谨慎态度  
  有些评论者对2024年持谨慎乐观的态度。他们承认科技和经济的潜在进步，但担心这些变化可能会带来社会不平等的加剧。他们指出，如果政策不当，技术进步可能只会让少数人受益，而大部分人会被抛在后面。

• 观点三：对2024年持悲观态度  
  另一部分评论者对2024年表示担忧。他们认为全球政治局势的不稳定和环境问题将对社会造成严重影响。他们特别提到气候变化可能会导致更多的自然灾害，而国际关系的紧张可能会引发地区冲突。

• 观点四：中立且观望态度  
  还有一部分人持中立态度，认为2024年既有积极的一面，也有消极的一面。他们对未来保持观望，认为具体发展将取决于多方面的因素，如政策执行、国际合作和科技创新等。

补充讨论：
• 争议的焦点在于科技进步和经济增长是否能够惠及大多数人。持乐观态度的人认为技术进步和经济复苏会带来广泛的社会效益，而持悲观态度的人则担心这些进步可能会加剧社会不平等。
• 有评论者提出，应该更加关注政策制定和社会保障体系的完善，以确保科技和经济进步的成果能够被更广泛地分享。
• 环保和气候变化问题也是讨论中的重要议题，一些人认为，如果不能有效应对气候变化，其他方面的进步可能都会被环境问题所抵消。

• [energy123] 则更关注当前市场对特朗普关税政策的反应，认为市场仍在期待关税政策可能发生变化，比如通过国会或法院的干预，甚至特朗普被弹劾。他批评特朗普对关税的固执态度，并指出特朗普缺乏经济学基本常识，具有零和博弈的世界观，且非常固执和顽固，这将导致情况更加恶化。

补充讨论：
• [aurareturn] 强调了全球贸易格局变化对美国经济地位的潜在负面影响，特别是美国产品和服务在国际市场上可能失去竞争力。

• [energy123] 则集中讨论了特朗普政府关税政策对市场的直接影响，特别是政策不确定性对市场的负面效应，以及特朗普个人特质对政策走向的影响。

• 关于中美及全球关税变化对美国经济的长远影响存在不同看法。[aurareturn] 认为美国可能比其他国家受到更大影响，而 [energy123] 更关注当前市场对特朗普关税政策的直接反应，以及特朗普个人政策倾向带来的不确定性。

• 另一个争议点在于政策的不确定性及其对市场的影响。 [energy123] 认为市场仍在期待政策改变，而 [aurareturn] 更关注关税政策变化对贸易格局的长期影响。
